plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-cost-meter

A DeepSeek Harness plugin that shows one ambient line below the Web composer:
the estimated model cost of the current session, and the remaining balance of
the provider route in use.

```
[ Composer card                                 ]
      Cost $0.0142 · Balance $12.50
```

Hovering a pill shows its breakdown: token buckets per model route for the cost,
and topped-up versus granted credit for the balance.

## Requirements

- DeepSeek Harness with the Web app (`dsh web`). The balance read needs the
  `connection` and `credentials` services, which the shipped Web composition
  provides.
- For the balance pill, a wallet endpoint plus a stored credential for it; the
  built-in default is DeepSeek's Platform balance endpoint with a
  `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY` credential reference. Cost needs nothing: prices ship in the
  row config.

## Install

```sh
# 1. install the package into a profile
dsh plugin --profile web add github:dsh-plugin-db/dsh-cost-meter

# …or from a local checkout
dsh plugin --profile web add link:/path/to/dsh-cost-meter
```

2. Enable the bundle: **Settings → Plugins → Installed → dsh-cost-meter → on**.
   (An agent driving the plugin manager does both steps at once with
   `install_bundle`.)

The package ships a bundle patch, so enabling it inserts the row with built-in
defaults. Cost works immediately; the balance pill appears once a wallet source
answers. The credential reference is resolved on the Host, so the secret never
reaches the browser.

## Configuration

Every value lives in the row config, so it survives DSH upgrades in the
profile's own `cordis.patch.yml` (highest-priority layer):

```yaml
- id: dsh-cost-meter
  name: 'dsh-cost-meter'
  config:
    prices:
      - provider: '*'        # '*' matches any route; a literal provider wins over '*'
        model: deepseek-flash
        currency: USD
        input: 0.3           # per 1M cache-miss input tokens
        output: 1.2          # per 1M output tokens
        cacheRead: 0.006     # per 1M cache-hit input tokens
        cacheWrite: 0.3      # optional; defaults to `input`
        offPeak:             # optional; used outside `peakWindows`
          input: 0.15
          output: 0.6
          cacheRead: 0.003
          cacheWrite: 0.15
    peakWindows:             # optional; defaults to DeepSeek's published windows
      - { startHourUtc: 1, endHourUtc: 4, weekdaysOnly: true }
      - { startHourUtc: 6, endHourUtc: 10, weekdaysOnly: true }
    balances:                # optional; provider route → wallet endpoint
      - provider: deepseek-official
        url: https://api.deepseek.com/user/balance
        credential: DEEPSEEK_API_KEY   # credential reference resolved in the Host
        auth: bearer                   # or x-api-key
        timeoutMs: 10000
```

Lookup specificity is `provider+model` → `provider+*` → `*+model` → `*+*`. A
route with no matching row still shows its token count, and the cost pill is
prefixed with "at least" while unpriced calls exist, so an estimate never
pretends to be complete.

Shipped defaults are DeepSeek's published list prices for `deepseek-flash` and
`deepseek-v4-pro` (per 1M tokens, USD) with their peak/off-peak windows. Prices
change; edit them in the profile patch.

## Balance

The Client reads the balance in two steps, and reports what it finds:

1. The signed-in DeepSeek account through `ctx.remote.account.getBalance`, for
   routes whose provider starts with `deepseek`.
2. This plugin's Host route, asked for the exact route the session is spending
   on. The Host matches that provider against `balances` (an exact provider wins
   over `*`), resolves the named credential through `ctx.credentials`, calls the
   endpoint, and answers with the wallet amounts only.

A route the Host prices no wallet for (`unsupported-provider`) shows nothing, so
the pill never appears for a provider that simply has no `balances` row. Every
other outcome is visible: the amount when the wallets are read, and `Balance —`
with the reason in its tooltip when the credential is missing, the endpoint
fails, or the route does not answer at all. That reason carries the HTTP status
and the body, which separates the two silent failures: a browser sees
`404 not found` when this build's route is not mounted, and `401 unauthorized`
when the request never reached it.

The key never reaches the browser, and the endpoint is ordinary configuration:
another provider whose API returns a wallet needs a new `balances` row plus a
parser kind in `index.js`. Amounts are re-read once a minute; each pill carries
its own currency, so a USD cost and a CNY balance never get conflated.

## How it is built

| Half | File | Role |
|---|---|---|
| Host | `index.js` | One `sessionProjections` unit (`costMeter`) that prices provider-reported usage, plus one balance route on Connection's `/api` channel |
| Client | `client.js` | One `conversation.composer.dock` entry that renders the wire value and reads the balance |

The Host folds the durable Session log and publishes one client-visible
projection; the Client renders it through the `useProjection` slot prop. Both
halves were written against documented seams only:

- `ctx.sessionProjections.register({key, stateVersion, stateSchema, init, apply, wire})` —
  projection units; the registry calls only `schema.parse`, so the schemas here
  are small hand-written normalizers with no schema-library dependency.
- The `SessionEvent` envelope and payloads: `request/header` (route),
  `assistant/message` / `assistant/attempt` (usage, from `data.usage` or the
  last `usage` chunk of the compact stream), `llm/retry-started` (retry
  replacement slot) and `compaction/summary` (its own route and usage).
  Unrecognized events return the same state reference, which the registry's
  `Object.is` gate turns into zero downstream work.
- `ctx.slots.inject(key, () => ctx.slots.register(options, Component))` and the
  slot's standard `useProjection` prop.
- `ctx.locale.register(ns, dicts)` with `locale: ns` on the slot registration.
- The row `Config` is a **Standard Schema** object (`~standard.validate`), which
  is exactly what Cordis `resolveConfig` reads, so no `schemastery` import is
  needed. (The Config inspector reports such a schema as `unsupported`, so the
  Plugins page draws no generated form; edit the values in YAML instead.)
- Balances come from two documented read paths: the generated Client namespace
  `ctx.remote.account.getBalance(metadata)` for a signed-in account, and this
  plugin's own **exact Fetch route** on Connection's `/api` channel
  (`/api/dsh-cost-meter.balance`) for an API-key route. The route registers on a
  separate optional child fiber that injects `connection` and `credentials`, and
  the Client reaches it with the page's plain `fetch` — the same pattern shipped
  UI plugins use (e.g. `/api/present.open` in `dsh-client-ui-deliverables`,
  `/api/session.export` in `dsh-session-log-export`), which needs no Client
  service to be resolved either. Two details are pinned because getting them
  wrong is silent:
  - An exact route must be **one segment directly under `/api`**
    (`assertFetchRoute` → `endpointFromPath('/api', path)`), which is why the
    path is dotted rather than nested.
  - `connection.rpc.handle` is *not* used: it mounts its route on the **caller's**
    context (`owner.webServer.register(route)`), so it dies unless that fiber
    also declares `webServer`, whereas `connection.fetch.register` only writes
    into Connection's own route table. `verify.mjs` pins the dependency list and
    the route shape.

Both read paths are optional at runtime (`ctx.get()`), so the plugin still
activates and still shows cost in a composition without them. No Harness Client
package is imported, no DOM outside the component is written, no session event
is appended, and no credential ever leaves the Host process: the balance route
answers with wallet amounts only.

## Verification

`node verify.mjs` runs 25 dependency-free checks with no browser and no running
profile: the Config schema, the balance route's dependency list and shape, the
fold's pricing and replacement rules, every balance-route ou

plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-opencode-doctor

[English](README.en.md) | **中文**

**给 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）装上「已经实测过可用性」的 OpenCode 模型路由。**

哪些模型真能用、哪些被地区封锁 —— 装完在选择器里一眼看到；被封锁的自动走你本地的代理，额度还能一条命令查出来。

[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE)
[![Node](https://img.shields.io/badge/node-%3E%3D20.18-brightgreen.svg)](package.json)
[![GitHub topic](https://img.shields.io/badge/topic-dsh--plugin-blueviolet.svg)](https://github.com/topics/dsh-plugin)

---

## 0.2.2 更新了什么

| 更新 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| 🤝 **官方插件一起装** | `dsh-opencode-go` 成为本插件的依赖并被自动激活 —— 不用再单独装一次，额度胶囊和账号设置页直接可用 |
| 🔌 **代理端口可改** | 新增 `--proxy` 参数和 `OPENCODE_DOCTOR_PROXY` 环境变量，端口不再是硬编码 |
| 🔍 **`check` 会查冲突** | 直接报出「你自己的 patch 会覆盖掉本插件的路由」和「`model-proxy` / `opencode-go` 被重复插入」这类静默问题 |
| 📌 **安装带 tag** | 安装命令固定到版本 tag，不再装浮动的 `main` |

### 0.2.0 有什么

| 更新 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| 🌏 **地区限制自动跳过** | 15 个被地区封锁的模型自动走本地代理（默认 `127.0.0.1:7897`），其余模型继续直连，互不影响 |
| 🔑 **网关自包含** | `dsh-model-proxy` 已写成依赖，装插件时自动装上，不用你另外找东西装 |
| 🧹 **标注更干净** | 已经修好的问题不再写在模型名里 —— 「地区限制」这几个字已经消失 |
| ★ **常用模型清单** | 10 个最常用的模型加了 ★，选择器里输入 ★ 直接筛出来 |
| 📊 **额度查询** | 新增 `usage` 命令：已用 / 剩余 / 本周 / 本月，一屏看完 |
| 🐛 **协议分派修复** | 之前模型碰到「地区限制」就停止换协议，会被错误地塞进 OpenAI 路由；现在会继续试到真正能跑的那条 |

## 解决什么问题

网关的 `/models` 接口告诉你它**能提供**什么，不告诉你你**有权用**什么。

地区封锁、余额不足、只限官方客户端的免费层 —— 这些只有真的发一次请求才会暴露。等你选中模型、写好 prompt、按下回车，才发现它根本跑不了。

这个插件把这件事**提前做完**：79 个模型，每一个都真发过一次请求，结论直接写进模型名。

## 效果

DSH 的模型选择器只渲染模型名（不显示描述字段），所以可用性结论就写在名字里：

```
★ Claude Opus 5.5
★ Claude Sonnet 5.5
★ Grok 4.7
★ DeepSeek V4.1 Flash
★ GPT-5.3 Codex
Claude Fable 5（需充值）
Cat Jam Free（限官方客户端）
```

**已经修好的问题不再标注。** 地区封锁的 15 个模型现在由插件自己走代理，名字里干干净净 —— 之前的「（地区限制）」字样不会出现了。

顺带的好处：选择器自带模糊搜索。

- 输入「**★**」→ 只剩常用模型
- 输入「**需充值**」→ 筛出余额不足的那组
- 输入「**限官方客户端**」→ 排除只能官方客户端用的免费层

## 安装

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:fffcodefox/dsh-opencode-doctor#v0.2.2
```

**tag 一定要带。** 不带 tag 装的是浮动的 `main`，别人拿到的版本无法复现，你以后往 main 推什么都会直接打到所有已安装的人身上。

装完**重启 dsh**，进 **设置 → 模型**，就能看到下面这些新路由。

> **官方插件一起装好了。** `dsh-opencode-go` 写在本插件的 `dependencies` 里，安装时自动带上，并由本插件的 patch 自动激活 —— 你**不需要**再单独装一次，也不需要把它加进 `dsh.profile.bundles`。额度胶囊、账号设置页都跟着一起来。
>
> 不想要它？在自己的 profile patch 里写：
>
> ```yaml
> - id: opencode-go
>   disabled: true
> ```

> **纯配置插件。** 它的全部行为都在 `cordis.patch.yml` 里，不跑任何运行时代码（`lib/index.mjs` 的 `apply` 是空的，只为符合插件规范）。所以它不会影响 DSH 宿主的稳定性，也不会碰你的其它配置。
>
> 唯一的例外是上面那条 `opencode-go`：它会让官方插件在同一个 profile 里跑起来。两个插件可以共存（路由 id 不同），代价是同一个模型在选择器里出现两份 —— 想只留带标注的那份，用官方插件自己的 `modelVisibility` 把它的模型藏掉。

## 地区限制是怎么跳过的

探测发现 15 个模型在中国大陆被封锁（`unsupported_country_region_territory`）。插件不再只是把它们标出来，而是让它们**走代理出去**：

```
你在 DSH 里选 gpt-6-luna
        │
        ├─ 命中代理清单？──是──→ 127.0.0.1:7897 ──→ opencode.ai   ✅
        │                              （探测不到就自动回落直连）
        └──────────────否────────────→ 直连 opencode.ai             ✅
```

- **按模型分流，不做全局代理。** 只有清单里的 15 个模型走代理，其它模型一点不受影响 —— 不会出现「本来能直连的模型被代理带慢」的情况。
- **清单是精确 id，不是通配符。** 避免误伤本来正常的模型。
- **没代理也能用。** `fallbackToDirect` 打开着：代理连不上时，这些模型退回直连，行为和你没装插件时一样。
- **只拦 opencode.ai。** 出口规则限定在这个域名。

### 代理端口不是 7897 怎么改？

默认值 `http://127.0.0.1:7897` 只是 Clash Verge / Mihomo 的常用端口，**不是要求**。三种改法，按省事程度排：

**1. 命令行重写（推荐）** —— 重新生成 patch，端口跟着写进去：

```bash
npx dsh-opencode-doctor render --proxy http://127.0.0.1:7890
```

`probe` 接受同一个参数，重探模型时会一起写进去：

```bash
npx dsh-opencode-doctor probe --proxy http://127.0.0.1:10809
```

不想每次敲参数，就设个环境变量，`render` / `probe` 都会用它：

```bash
OPENCODE_DOCTOR_PROXY=http://127.0.0.1:7890 npx dsh-opencode-doctor render
```

当前生效的值不用猜 —— `npx dsh-opencode-doctor check` 第一行就会打出来。

**2. 在 profile patch 里覆盖** —— 适合不想动插件目录的人：

```yaml
# ~/.dsh/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml
- id: model-proxy
  name: dsh-model-proxy
  config:
    enabled: true
    proxy: "http://127.0.0.1:7890"   # ← 只改这里
    origins:
      - opencode.ai
    models: [ ... 原样抄过来 ... ]
    fallbackToDirect: true
```

DSH 的 patch 是**整体替换** `config` 对象（不是深合并），所以要连 `origins` / `models` 一起抄过去，只改 `proxy` 那一行。

**3. 直接改插件目录里的 `cordis.patch.yml`** —— 能跑，但升级插件会覆盖，不推荐。

**端口写错了会怎样？** 不会崩。`fallbackToDirect: true` 让这些模型回落直连 —— 行为和没装插件一样，只是那 15 个地区受限模型连不上。而且它们名字里**不带**标注（插件认为已经修好了），所以如果你发现它们报错，第一个要查的就是这个端口。

> **只留一条 `model-proxy` 行。** 如果 `dsh-model-proxy` 也被单独列在你 profile 的 `dsh.profile.bundles` 里，它自带的 patch 会再插一条（默认 7890）—— 两条同 id 的行是**串联**而不是覆盖，请把那个名字从 bundles 列表里删掉。`npx dsh-opencode-doctor check` 会把这种情况直接报出来。作为本插件的依赖，它照样装着、能被解析到。

## ★ 常用模型

选择器里没有「收藏」这个功能，但名字可以模糊搜索 —— 所以把最常用的 10 个模型加了 ★ 前缀，**输入 ★ 就只剩它们**：

`Claude Opus 5.5` · `Claude Sonnet 5.5` · `Claude Haiku 5.5` · `GPT-5.3 Codex` · `Grok 4.7` · `DeepSeek V4.1 Flash` · `GLM-5.3` · `Kimi K3` · `Qwen3.8 Max` · `MiniMax-M3`

同一个模型出现在多条路由上时会**都**带星，所以不管它最后落在哪个协议，都筛得出来。

## 额度查询

不用再登网页翻额度，一条命令：

```bash
npx dsh-opencode-doctor usage
```

```
OpenCode Go 额度  st_96e…c4d9 ← ~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml → refs.OPENCODE_API_KEY

  窗口             已用  用掉                   剩余   重置
  滚动窗口 rolling  41%  ████████░░░░░░░░░░░░    59%   10-16 01:18
  本周     weekly   49%  ██████████░░░░░░░░░░    51%   10-19 08:00
  本月     monthly  24%  █████░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░    76%   11-13 23:55
```

- 三个窗口就是官方面板里的滚动窗口 / 本周 / 本月，`剩余 = 100 − 已用`。
- 进度条到 70% 变黄、90% 变红，快用完了一眼就能看出来。
- 加 `--json` 可以接进脚本。
- key 只以 `st_96e…c4d9` 这种打码形式显示，不会完整打印。

## 覆盖范围

路由按**实际能跑通的协议**生成，所以不是每个网关都有三条。下面是发布时的实测结果（探测日期见 `models.catalog.json`）：

| 路由 id | 协议 | 可用 / 总数 | 端点 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `opencode-go-doctor-anthropic` | Anthropic Messages | 2 / 2 | `opencode.ai/inference/go/v1/messages` |
| `opencode-go-doctor-openai` | OpenAI 兼容 | 30 / 31 | `opencode.ai/inference/go/openai/v1` |
| `opencode-go-doctor-responses` | OpenAI Responses | 4 / 4 | `opencode.ai/inference/go/openai/v1` |
| `opencode-zen-doctor-anthropic` | Anthropic Messages | 7 / 8 | `opencode.ai/inference/v1/messages` |
| `opencode-zen-doctor-openai` | OpenAI 兼容 | 11 / 21 | `opencode.ai/inference/v1` |
| `opencode-zen-doctor-responses` | OpenAI Responses | 13 / 13 | `opencode.ai/inference/v1` |

**合计 67 个无标注 / 79 个模型下发**，覆盖 Claude、GPT、Grok、DeepSeek、GLM、Qwen、Kimi、MiniMax 等系列。其中 15 个靠上面的代理才能连上。

同一个模型在不同协议下的可用性并不一致 —— 比如 Zen 的 Claude 只认 Anthropic Messages，`grok-4.7` 只认 Responses，`gpt-6-luna` 只在 Responses + 代理下能跑。`probe` 会逐个协议试，把模型归到它**真正能跑**的那条路由上。

## 标注词汇

| 标注 | 含义 |
|---|---|
| （需充值） | 账户余额不足 |
| （限官方客户端） | 免费层模型，只能在 OpenCode 官方客户端里用 |
| （需授权训练数据） | 需要先授权用你的数据训练 |
| （暂不可用） | 其它失败 |

**没有标注 = 探测时可用。** 地区封锁的模型**不在这里**：它们已经被插件修好（走代理），所以名字里不留字。

> 探测内部仍然会记录「地区限制」这个结论（`models.catalog.json` 里的 `code: region`）—— 它决定了谁进代理清单。只是不再写进模型名。

## 凭证

插件从 `refs.OPENCODE_API_KEY` 读 key，按这个顺序找：

1. 环境变量 `OPENCODE_API_KEY` / `OPENCODE_GO_API_KEY` / `OPENCODE_ZEN_API_KEY`
2. `$DSH_HOME/.credentials.yaml`（默认 `~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml`）的 `refs` 块
3. OpenCode 自己的 `auth.json`（`~/.local/share/opencode/`、`$OPENCODE_DATA/`、`%APPDATA%\opencode\`）

```yaml
# ~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml
refs:
  OPENCODE_API_KEY: st_xxxxxxxx
```

已经装过 `dsh-opencode-go` 的话，key 名是同一个，**不用重复配置**。

**你的 key 不会被写进插件或仓库。** `cordis.patch.yml` 里只有 `apiKeyEnv: OPENCODE_API_KEY` 这个变量名，key 本体在 DSH 启动时从上面这些位置读，请求时放在 `Authorization` 头里发给 opencode.ai —— 和官方客户端做的事一样。

## CLI

装完之后有个 `dsh-opencode-doctor` 命令（`npx dsh-opencode-doctor` 也行）：

```bash
npx dsh-opencode-doctor list      # 看目录里有什么、哪些被标注（离线）
npx dsh-opencode-doctor usage     # 查 Go 套餐额度：已用 / 剩余 / 本周 / 本月
npx dsh-opencode-doctor check     # 凭证、两个网关、以及组合冲突，一次查完
npx dsh-opencode-doctor probe     # 重新探测，重写 catalog + patch
npx dsh-opencode-doctor render    # 只从 catalog 重新生成 patch（离线）
```

`probe` 会对每个模型真发一次请求，结果写回 `models.catalog.json` 和 `cordis.patch.yml`。日常用不着跑 —— 只有网关更新了模型、或你想重新确认一遍时再跑。**重跑 probe 也会自动刷新代理清单**，网关哪天放开某个模型的地区限制，它会自动回到直连。

常用参数：`--gateway <slug>` 只测一个网关、`--concurrency <n>` 并发数、`--timeout <ms>` 单请求超时、`--key <key>` 直接给 key、`--proxy <url>` 出口代理（`probe` / `render` 用）。

`check` 不打网络请求也能干活 —— 它先读本机配置，把**会让插件静默失效的组合**报出来（你自己的 patch 覆盖了 `llm-pi-ai`、`model-proxy` / `opencode-go` 被重复插入），然后才去验证凭证和网关。装完插件先跑一次这个。

## 常见问题

**我没有代理，装了会不会变差？**
不会。代理连不上时清单里的模型自动回落直连（`fallbackToDirect`），表现和你没装插件一样；其它 64 个模型本来就走直连。

**我本来就在用 `dsh-model-proxy`，会打架吗？**
会重复。`dsh-model-proxy` 自己带的 bundle patch 也会插一条 `model-proxy`（默认 `127.0.0.1:7890`，只匹配 `grok-*` / `gpt-*-luna`）。两条同 id 的行**不会互相覆盖**，而是串成两条 dispatcher —— 于是 `grok-*` 会先去敲 7890。把它从 profile 的 `dsh.profile.bundles` 列表里删掉即可：它作为本插件的依赖仍然装着、

plugins.description: DSH 插件：向模型暴露 Komari 探针面板工具（列机器、远程执行、上传下载文件），设置页配置面板地址与账号 | DSH plugin exposing Komari monitoring-panel tools (list nodes, remote exec, file transfer) with a settings-page config card
plugins.readme_text: # dsh-plugin-komari DSH 插件（bundle 形式）：把 [Komari](https://github.com/komari-monitor/komari) 探针面板的能力暴露给模型——**列机器**（节点清单 + 实时状态）、**控制机器**（远程执行命令）与**传输文件**（本机 ↔ 目标机），并在 WebUI 设置页配置面板地址与账号。四个工具经 [dsh-plugin-toolsets](https://github.com/huanlinoto/dsh-plugin-toolsets) 注册为一个**按需加载的工具集**。 DSH plugin (bundle): exposes a Komari monitoring panel to the model — list machines with live status, run shell commands on them, and move files between this machine and them — configured from the WebUI settings page. Tools ship as one lazily-loaded toolset through dsh-plugin-toolsets. ## 工具集（按需加载） 四个工具注册为名为 `komari` 的 toolset：平常只占一行目录（名称 + 「什么时候该用」摘要 + 工具数），模型判断需要时调用全局 `get_tools({"toolset":"komari"})` 把整组工具加载进当前 agent，**下一轮**起可用。 - 依赖 `@huanlin/dsh-plugin-toolsets`（peer，需已安装，否则本插件的 `inject: ['toolsets']` 不满足、不会加载）。 - 目录行内容即 [src/tools.ts](src/tools.ts) 里的 `TOOLSET_DESCRIPTION`。 - 子 agent 不继承：子 agent 需自行调用 `get_tools`。 ## 工具 | 工具 | 作用 | |------|------| | `komari_list_nodes` | 列出面板上的机器及其实时状态（在线、CPU%、负载、内存/磁盘/Swap、网络总量、运行时长、连接数、温度、系统、备注）。参数：`group`（分组精确过滤）、`include_offline`（默认 true）。 | | `komari_exec` | 在一台或多台机器上执行 shell 命令，返回每台的输出与 exit code。参数：`command`、`nodes`（uuid / 精确名称 / 唯一名称子串）、`wait_seconds`（默认 30，最大 300）。 | | `komari_upload_file` | 把**本机**（运行 dsh 的机器）的文件传到一台或多台机器。参数：`local_path`、`remote_path`、`nodes`。走面板分片上传协议，单文件上限 8 GiB。 | | `komari_download_file` | 把某台机器上的文件取回**本机**（流式写盘）。参数：`remote_path`、`node`、`local_path`（缺省写系统临时目录下的 `komari-downloads/`）。目录不可下载。 | `komari_upload_file` 会**覆盖目标路径上已存在的文件**，同样需要先确认。 `komari_exec` 是**危险工具**：命令经面板 agent 在目标机上以其自身权限执行（多数 Linux 节点即 root，Windows 节点为 agent 服务账户，走 PowerShell）。工具描述已要求模型在执行重启/删除/改配置/批量命令前先说明计划并取得用户明确同意；面板侧也会记录 `REC, task id: ...` 审计日志。 ## 设置页配置 「设置 → 插件」中找到 `@huanlin/dsh-plugin-komari` 这一行，展开其配置卡： | 字段 | 说明 | |------|------| | 面板地址 | 如 `https://status.example.com`；粘贴 `/api` 或 `/api/v1` 后缀会被自动去掉，无协议时默认补 `https://`。 | | 用户名 / 密码 | 面板账号，**必须是管理员**（远程执行是 admin 权限）。开启 2FA 的账号无法用于本插件（登录接口需要动态 TOTP 码）。 | | 请求超时 (ms) | 单次面板 HTTP 请求超时，默认 15000。 | 改完点「保存」即时生效（工具每次调用都读取最新配置，无需重启）；点「测试连接」会用当前已保存的配置做一次登录 + 拉取节点，验证地址与账号是否可用。 凭据以明文写入当前 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 中该 entry 的 `config` 下——请自行确认该文件的权限。 ## 文件传输备注 - 上传走面板的四步协议：`operation=init`（拿 `upload_id`/分片大小）→ 逐个 `operation=chunk`（原始字节，`Content-Length` 必须等于该分片期望长度）→ `operation=merge`（提交）；任一步失败会自动 `operation=cancel` 清掉半成品。 - 面板限制：单文件 ≤ 8 GiB，分片 1 MiB–128 MiB（默认 25 MiB），上传会话 15 分钟过期，最多 4 个并发上传（因此多机上传是串行执行的）。 - 下载是 `GET .../file/download?path=<绝对路径>` 的二进制流，插件边收边写盘；总时长受「传输超时」约束。 - 路径风格随目标机：Linux 用 `/tmp/...`，Windows agent 用 `C:\Windows\Temp\...`（面板会把它规范化成 `/C/Windows/Temp`）。 ## 数据可见性与安全 - 插件以面板**管理员会话**访问 `/api/admin/*`。`GET /api/admin/client/list` 的原始响应里含每台机器的 **Agent Token**，插件在进入模型之前用显式白名单投影（`pickNode`/`pickLive`），只保留状态字段；单元测试 `tests/komari.spec.ts` 钉死了这一行为。 - 会话 Cookie 只保存在宿主进程内存中；遇到 401/403 会清掉旧会话、重新登录并重试一次。 - 密码不写入日志、不回显在工具结果里。 ## 开发 ```sh pnpm install pnpm run build # tsdown: lib/index.js (host) + lib/client.js (browser half, __ModuleLoader__ 包裹) ``` 结构： | 路径 | 职责 | |------|------| | `src/index.ts` | 入口：`name` / `inject` / `Config`（全部字段 `.volatile()`）/ `apply` | | `src/komari.ts` | `KomariClient`：登录、Cookie 会话、`/api/rpc2`、`/api/admin/*`、字段白名单投影 | | `src/tools.ts` | 四个 `defineTool` 定义、`buildKomariToolset()` 与 `registerTools()`（注册到 `ctx.toolsets`） | | `src/transfer.ts` | 本地文件 IO：分片读取上传、流式写盘下载、默认落地路径 | | `src/summary.ts` | 纯函数：节点摘要、引用解析、文本渲染（无 `@deepseek-ai/*` 依赖，便于单测） | | `src/rpc.ts` | 宿主 RPC：`komari.probe`（设置卡「测试连接」） | | `src/client/*` | 浏览器半：`plugins.row.config` 配置卡（row key `@huanlin/dsh-plugin-komari#dsh-komari`） | | `cordis.patch.yml` | bundle 配置层：insert 一行 `dsh-komari`，`config` 是首次启动的种子值 | 约束：`lib/` 预构建入库（含 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-* ` peer，git 安装时无 `prepare`）；不改 DSH 源码。 ## 运行 ```sh # 本地开发（改源码后重新 pnpm run build 即可生效，无需重装） dsh plugin --profile web add "link:D:/Projects/deepseek-harness/dsh-plugin-komari" # 从远端安装 dsh plugin --profile web add "github:huanlinoto/dsh-plugin-komari" ``` 装好后**重启 `dsh web` 进程**，浏览器硬刷新（`Ctrl+Shift+R`），再到「设置 → 插件」填上面四个字段。 ## 检查 ```sh pnpm run typecheck # tsc --noEmit pnpm test # 40 个单测（mock fetch；含 token 不泄漏回归、分片协议回归、toolset 契约） pnpm vitest run tests/e2e.komari.spec.ts # 真实面板 e2e（未设置环境变量时自跳过） ``` 真实面板 e2e 需要： ```powershell $env:KOMARI_E2E_ENDPOINT='https://status.example.com' $env:KOMARI_E2E_USERNAME='admin' $env:KOMARI_E2E_PASSWORD='...' ``` 它覆盖四条链路：登录 + 列机器、读实时状态、在**一台在线机器**上执行 `echo dsh-komari-e2e`、以及**文件往返**（上传一个小文本文件到在线机器的临时目录 → stat 校验 → 下载回来比对内容 → 删除远端文件）。只跑无害命令与临时文件。 ## 已知限制 - 面板账号开启 2FA 时无法使用：登录与 `admin:exec` 都需要动态 TOTP 码。需要这种场景时应改用面板 API Key 认证（当前未实现）。 - 只覆盖「看机器 + 控制机器 + 传文件」：节点增删改、Ping 任务管理等面板管理写入接口未暴露。 - 强依赖 `@huanlin/dsh-plugin-toolsets`：未安装时本插件因 `inject` 不满足而整体不加载（工具不可见）。

plugins.description: Cross-session artifact center for DeepSeek Harness: agent tools register deliverable files (PDF/Excel/PPT/code/JSON) into one shared folder, plus a sidebar panel that filters them by category, extension or keyword.
plugins.readme_text:
# 产物中心 · Artifact Center

> DeepSeek Harness（DSH / Cordis）插件：**agent 每次产出重要文件都会登记进一个跨会话的产物中心**，
> 左侧边栏提供面板，按分类 / 后缀 / 关键词即时筛选。

每个对话都在产出文件——报告 PDF、Excel 数据表、PPT、脚本、JSON——但它们散落在各会话的工作目录里，换个对话就找不到了。
本插件把「值得留下的产物」集中到一处：

- **agent 侧**：4 个工具。产出文件时调用 `artifact_save` 登记，默认**复制一份**到统一目录，原目录被清理也不丢。
- **用户侧**：左侧边栏「产物中心」面板。分类 chip + 后缀 chip + 关键词搜索，可复制路径、在文件夹中显示、删除。
- **跨会话**：索引与副本都在 `~/.dsh/artifact-center/`，所有对话共用同一份。

```
┌ 左侧边栏 ────────┐
│ 对话             │
│ 自动化任务       │
│ 产物中心   ← 面板行 │──┐
│ 插件管理         │  │
└──────────────────┘  │
                      ▼
┌ 产物中心 ───────────────────────────────────────┐
│ 分类  [全部] [pdf 3] [excel 2] [code 5] …     刷新│
│ 后缀  [.pdf 3] [.xlsx 2] [.py 4] [.json 1]      │
│ 搜索标题 / 文件名 / 路径 / 备注 / 标签            │
│ ─────────────────────────────────────────────── │
│ 季度报告.pdf      PDF  2.0 MB  复制路径 显示 删除 │
│ train.py          代码 4.1 KB  …                │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

## 安装

```sh
# 从 GitHub 安装（推荐）
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:lishuo4096/artifact-center

# 本地开发：link 到源码目录
dsh plugin --profile desktop add link:/path/to/artifact-center
```

也可以在插件市场（dshmarket）里搜索 `artifact-center` 一键安装。

装完**重启 DSH**（宿主的插件模块走 ESM 缓存，改完源码或新装插件都需要重启才加载新代码）；
重启后左侧边栏出现「产物中心」，对 agent 说话时 `artifact_save` 等工具即可用。

## agent 工具

| 工具 | 参数 | 作用 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `artifact_save` | `path`（必填）、`title`、`note`、`tags[]`、`mode`（`copy` 默认 / `link`） | 登记一个产物。`copy` 会把文件复制进统一目录；`link` 只记路径不动文件 |
| `artifact_list` | `ext`、`category`、`keyword` | 列出/筛选产物，三个过滤条件可组合 |
| `artifact_stats` | — | 按分类、按后缀的计数 |
| `artifact_remove` | `id`（必填） | 删除条目。`copy` 产物连副本一起删；`link` 产物只删条目，**永不碰原文件** |

工具的返回值是结构化 JSON；`artifact_save` 的 `path` 不存在或不是文件时返回 `{ok:false,message}`，不会抛异常打断对话。

## 面板

左侧边栏「产物中心」，与工具读写同一份索引：

- **分类 chip**：`pdf` / `excel` / `ppt` / `word` / `image` / `code` / `data` / `archive` / `other`，带计数，计数为 0 且未选中的不显示。
- **后缀 chip**：按真实后缀分组（`.pdf`、`.py`、`.json`…），按数量降序。
- **搜索框**：服务端匹配标题、文件名、路径、备注、标签（输入 220ms 防抖）。
- **每行操作**：复制路径 · 在文件夹中显示（Windows `explorer /select`、macOS `open`、Linux `xdg-open`）· 删除（二次确认）。

## 数据与配置

```
~/.dsh/artifact-center/
├── index.json   # 索引：id / 原标题 / 原路径 / 存储路径 / mode / 分类 / 后缀 / 大小 / 备注 / 标签 / 所属会话 / 时间
└── files/       # copy 模式的副本
```

索引写入是串行队列（不会两个 tool 调用互相覆盖）。默认根目录是 `~/.dsh/artifact-center`，
可用插件配置 `rootDir` 覆盖：

```yaml
# cordis.patch.yml（用户覆盖层）
- id: artifact-center
  config:
    rootDir: D:/artifacts
```

## HTTP 路由（面板的数据通道）

面板通过宿主 `webServer` 的同源路由取数据，不需要额外服务：

| 路由 | 方法 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `/artifact-center/api/state` | GET | `?ext=&category=&keyword=` → `{ok, items, stats, rootDir, categories}` |
| `/artifact-center/api/remove` | POST | `{id}` → 删除条目 |
| `/artifact-center/api/reveal` | POST | `{id}` → 在文件管理器里定位；只接受索引里的 id，路径由服务端解析 |

三条路由都带**同源栅栏**：带跨站 `Origin` 的请求直接 403；写操作必须 `content-type: application/json`
（跨站表单这类「简单请求」不触发预检，声明 JSON 则会预检，而预检打到本路由必然 405/415）；
非浏览器调用（curl / node，没有 Origin）照常可用。`reveal` 不接受任意路径参数，所以无法被用来打开任意文件。

没有 `webServer` 的形态（纯 CLI）下，面板这段不激活，4 个工具照常工作。

## 目录结构

```
artifact-center/
├── package.json          # dsh.bundle.patch + dsh.client（web）
├── cordis.patch.yml      # 注册进 profile 的 patch 行
├── index.js              # 宿主半边：4 个工具 + 3 条同源路由
├── client.js             # 浏览器半边：侧边栏面板行 + 面板页（window.__ModuleLoader__ 形态）
├── lib/
│   ├── defineTool.js     # 作者侧工具 DSL → 宿主 JSON Schema（零依赖，必须带）
│   └── store.js          # 索引与副本的存储层（串行写、分类规则）
└── test/
    └── local-smoke.mjs   # 离线自检：81 项断言，不需要 DSH 就能跑
```

`lib/defineTool.js` 不是可选的装饰：宿主真正加载的是 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools` 的 `defineTool`，
但在 profile 里以 `link:` 安装的插件**不能 import 任何 `@deepseek-ai/*`**（它们只在 app.asar 内，Node 解析不到），
所以插件必须自带一份等价实现。作者的 `parameters` 用 `required: true` 这种 DSL 写法，`output.schema: {type:'json'}` 表示无约束 JSON。

## 开发与自检

```sh
node test/local-smoke.mjs
```

零依赖，不需要启动 DSH：伪造 `ctx` / `req` / `res` 后覆盖工具行为（复制落盘、link 不复制、删除 link 不动原文件、
筛选与统计）、三条路由（含同源/方法/content-type 栅栏）、`client.js` 的装载与渲染（用 stub React 渲染空态、
有数据、筛选无命中、错误态），以及**工具 schema 必须通过宿主 `assertSupportedJsonSchema`** 这条回归护栏
（作者侧 `type:'json'` 若被原样透传，宿主 `register()` 会同步抛错，进而中断整个 `apply()`——本插件踩过这个坑）。

## 兼容性

- 面板需要 Web GUI（宿主 `webServer` 同源路由 + `sidebar.panellist` / `main` 插槽）。
- 纯 CLI 形态下工具可用，面板不显示。
- 已在本机 DSH 桌面版（Electron，Web GUI `http://127.0.0.1:19387`）上实测：面板渲染、筛选、删除、
  在文件夹中显示，以及 4 个工具均正常。

## License

MIT

---

# Artifact Center (English)

A DeepSeek Harness (DSH / Cordis) plugin that gives every conversation a **shared artifact center**.

Agents produce files all the time — reports, spreadsheets, slides, scripts, JSON — and they end up scattered across
per-session working directories, effectively lost the moment the conversation changes. This plugin registers the
artifacts worth keeping, in one place:

- **Agent tools** — `artifact_save` (copies the file into a shared directory by default, or just records the path with
  `mode:"link"`), `artifact_list` (filter by `ext` / `category` / `keyword`), `artifact_stats`, `artifact_remove`.
- **Sidebar panel** — category chips with counts, extension chips with counts, keyword search, copy path,
  reveal in file manager, delete with confirmation.
- **Cross-session** — index and copies live in `~/.dsh/artifact-center/`, shared by every conversation.

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:lishuo4096/artifact-center
```

Restart DSH afterwards. The panel talks to the host over three same-origin routes under `/artifact-center/api/`
(`state`, `remove`, `reveal`); cross-origin requests are rejected, writes require `application/json`, and `reveal`
resolves paths server-side from the index so it cannot be used to open arbitrary files.

Run `node test/local-smoke.mjs` for the dependency-free self-check (81 assertions covering the tools, the routes,
the browser bundle and the tool-schema contract).

MIT licensed.

**English** | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)

# Engramory

[![CI](https://github.com/tinqiao-oss/engramory/actions/workflows/test.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/tinqiao-oss/engramory/actions/workflows/test.yml)
[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE)
[![Python 3.9+](https://img.shields.io/badge/python-3.9%2B-blue.svg)](https://www.python.org/)

**An opinionated, zero-infrastructure memory *protocol* for small-scale, local,
file-based agent memory** — a strict curation discipline plus a validator
(`tools/engramory_doctor.py`), loaded as **standing rules** (`CLAUDE.md` /
`AGENTS.md` / your host's rules file). It is not a database, a framework, or a
relevance-loaded skill. Memory is a folder of small, human-readable markdown files
plus one always-loaded index. No database, no embeddings, no server — just
plain-text files you can open, read, edit, and diff in any editor (the live store
itself stays git-ignored).

> *Engramory* — coined from *engram* (the physical trace a memory leaves in the
> brain) + *memory*. Here: one file = one fact.

> ⚠️ **Unrelated projects share this name.** *engram + memory* is an obvious
> coinage and at least one other repository arrived at it independently. This
> project is only ever `tinqiao-oss/engramory` (npm: `dsh-engramory`); a same-named
> repo under a different owner is not a fork, a mirror, or a newer version of it.

> 🤖 **Are you an AI agent, asked to install or check this?** Start at
> **[AGENT-SETUP.md](AGENT-SETUP.md)**, not at the install steps below. It is the
> procedure for working out what your host can actually enforce, whether a store
> already exists, what you must not touch, and what to tell the user — the parts
> agents reliably get wrong when improvising.

> **Status: 0.12.1 — experimental.** The hard index cap (a `PreToolUse` hook) is
> deterministic for the matched direct-edit tools (`Edit | Write | MultiEdit`) but
> NOT a global write guard (shell tools — Bash, PowerShell, a background Monitor
> command — plus MCP file tools, external editors, and sync clients bypass it);
> the discipline loads as standing rules the model follows, so it's
> best-effort, not guaranteed on every task (see [SKILL.md](SKILL.md) §8). Assumes a
> single writer / serialized writes. Don't rely on it as a "mandatory, reliable,
> cross-agent" memory layer yet.

---

## What this is — and is NOT

Engramory is **not a new memory architecture**. The "markdown files + a small index
loaded into context + the model curates it" pattern is now the mainstream shape
for agent memory, and it ships in several places already. Engramory stands on:

- **Claude Code native auto-memory** — the same markdown-`MEMORY.md`-index +
  lazy detail-file pattern; its system prompt even uses the same
  `user | feedback | project | reference` type vocabulary (per
  [anthropics/claude-code#58840](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/issues/58840);
  the *public docs* describe only the index + topic files). Engramory is a
  disciplined superset of this default.
- **[basic-memory](https://github.com/basicmachines-co/basic-memory)** — markdown
  source-of-truth, YAML frontmatter `type`, `[[wikilink]]` graph, local-first.
- **[obsidian-second-brain](https://github.com/eugeniughelbur/obsidian-second-brain)**,
  **[claude-memory-compiler](https://github.com/coleam00/claude-memory-compiler)**
  ("a loaded index beats vector search at personal scale"), and the broader family
  of markdown-memory skills.

What Engramory contributes is the **opinionated bundle + the discipline**, not the
primitives. Do not claim novelty on markdown, frontmatter, wikilinks, a loaded
index, one-file-per-fact notes, or curation hygiene — all are prior art.

## What's actually differentiated

1. **A role/purpose ontology, headed by `feedback` = procedural memory.** The
   semantic / episodic / **procedural** split is established prior art — the CoALA
   taxonomy, and a named procedural type in LangMem and mem0 — so Engramory does not
   claim the category. What it does is make procedural `feedback` the *spine* of a
   deliberately tiny, hand-authored, human-readable set, with required **Why:** /
   **How to apply:** lines, instead of auto-extracting it into a vector/graph store.
   The contribution is the packaging and discipline, not the ontology.

2. **The curation contract as concrete behaviour** the protocol applies (model-followed, not a hard gate): dedup-before-write,
   update-don't-duplicate, delete-when-wrong, and a negative-scope rule ("don't
   store what git/CLAUDE.md/the code already records"). Surveys consistently name
   *modify/delete/forget* as the most under-implemented memory operation — Engramory
   makes it the spine.

3. **A bounded index designed not to silently rot.** The index loads every session and
   Claude Code reads the first 200 lines / 25 KB (documented behavior), so an unbounded index silently
   drops memories off the end. Engramory warns at 150 lines / 20 KB, compacts-or-asks
   before 200 / 25 KB, and ships a hard `PreToolUse` hook backstop (it blocks only
   *growth* past the cap — shrinking/compaction edits always pass). Both the line and
   byte caps apply — whichever is hit first triggers (an index can be under the line
   count yet over on bytes when the lines run long).

   Claude Code has since followed up on this natively: v2.1.186 (released
   2026-06-22) reminds the agent to compact the index when it nears the cap, and
   v2.1.210 (released 2026-07-14) turned an over-cap write into an explicit error
   instead of a silent truncation. Both are after-the-fact alerts, though — the
   write still lands, and entries past the cap stay invisible until someone
   compacts. Engramory's hook denies the write *before* it happens, so a write
   through the matched edit tools never leaves the index over-cap in the first
   place (writes outside them — a shell, an MCP file tool — are not gated; see the
   status note above and SKILL.md §8). The native alerts validate the direction
   and make a welcome second layer — and older versions and other hosts still
   have neither.

## How it compares

| | storage | recall | human-readable | typed ontology | curation discipline | bounded index | infra |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Engramory** | md files | loaded index → open file | ✅ | ✅ role-based (4) | ✅ contract (model-run) | ✅ 150/200 + hook | none |
| CC auto-memory | md files | loaded index → open file | ✅ | ✅ same 4 types | partial (auto) | ~200-line window* | none (built-in) |
| basic-memory | md + SQLite | semantic/FTS search | ✅ | ✅ freeform type | schema + overwrite checks | ❌ (no loaded index) | SQLite + embeddings |
| obsidian-second-brain | md vault | index-first + search | ✅ | folder-typed | ✅ reconcile/lint | partial | none |
| mem0 / Zep | vector/graph DB | semantic | ❌ (DB) | typed (prefs/episodic/proc.; Zep custom) | auto-extract | n/a | DB + embeddings |
| [agentmemory](https://github.com/rohitg00/agentmemory) | SQLite + vector index (+opt. graph) | hybrid BM25+vector (+opt. graph), RRF | ❌ (DB/engine) | ✅ 4-tier lifecycle (work./epis./sem./proc.) | auto (capture + dedup + decay) | n/a | iii engine (local) + opt. embeddings |

Engramory's lane: **minimalism + actionable role typing + curation discipline, zero
infra.** It does *not* try to out-search basic-memory, out-scale mem0, or
out-capture agentmemory — those solve a different problem (auto-capture /
auto-ingest at volume) at a different cost point. agentmemory is the closest
heavyweight foil: also local-first, but it bets on automatic capture (lifecycle
hooks) + hybrid retrieval (BM25 + vectors + optional graph) on a SQLite/`iii`
engine, where Engramory bets on hand-curation + a tiny always-loaded index and
ships no engine at all.

\* Claude Code's [memory docs](https://docs.claude.com/en/docs/claude-code/memory)
document this exactly: *"the first 200 lines of `MEMORY.md`, or the first 25KB,
whichever comes first, are loaded at the start of every conversation."* Other hosts
vary, so the window stays configurable via the hook's env vars.

## Where it fits — and the goal

Engramory is a **portable memory *discipline*, not a

plugins.readme_text:
# jevcore
[![dshfind](https://dshfind.com/api/badge/PerryLink/jevcore?metric=downloads)](https://dshfind.com/plugins/PerryLink/jevcore?ref=badge)

[![DSH Market](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/2BingLing/dsh-market/master/assets/readme/badge-listed-en.svg)](https://dsh.market/)
[![OpenSSF Scorecard](https://api.securityscorecards.dev/projects/github.com/PerryLink/jevcore/badge)](https://api.securityscorecards.dev/projects/github.com/PerryLink/jevcore)
[![jevcore MCP server](https://glama.ai/mcp/servers/PerryLink/jevcore/badges/score.svg)](https://glama.ai/mcp/servers/PerryLink/jevcore)

TypeSafe [Jev](https://typesafe.ai) for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)
and any other MCP host.

Jev is not a chat model. It answers typed questions — `noul` (yes/no), `choice`, `score` — and returns
calibrated probabilities. It does not write prose, and asking it to is a category error. This project
gives an agent exactly that surface, and nothing more.

**Offline by default. Egress disclosed. Nothing default-on.**

---

**📖 Ecosystem knowledge base** — measured data, not marketing: [plugin development guide · plugin-selection data · maintenance criteria](https://perrylink.github.io/dsh-plugin-guide/).

<!-- star-cta -->
## ⭐ 如果它帮到了你

这个插件是 [DSH 插件家族](https://github.com/PerryLink)的一员（40+ 个，全部 Apache-2.0）。如果你在用，**给个 star** —— 它不会解锁任何功能，但会让下一个人在搜索里更容易找到它。

*English:* part of a 40+ plugin family for DeepSeek Harness. If it is useful, **a star helps the next person find it** — nothing is gated behind it.


## Three packages, one decision layer

| Package | What it is | Use it when |
|---|---|---|
| [`jevcore`](packages/core) | The decisions. Imports nothing from DeepSeek Harness or Cordis. | You want Jev in a plain script, a service, or your own harness |
| [`jevcore-dsh`](packages/dsh) | The DSH plugin: one service, three tools, two opt-in gates | You are running DeepSeek Harness |
| [`jevcore-mcp`](packages/mcp) | The same three tools over MCP, with a stdio binary | Your host speaks MCP but is not DSH |

The adapters are thin on purpose. `packages/dsh` is four files: it declares tool schemas and
translates hook payloads. Everything decision-shaped — the primitives, the providers, the egress
contract, the policy, the gates — lives in core, so a new adapter cannot drift from the guarantees
the others make.
One runtime requirement differs across the three: `jevcore-dsh` tracks the harness and needs
Node `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0`, while `jevcore` and `jevcore-mcp` need `>=20`.

---

## Why this exists

Between 2026-09-17 and 09-20, nineteen plugins appeared that wire Jev into DSH. Auditing their source
found a consistent pattern: the module labelled *guard*, *gate*, or *warden* was also the module
shipping prompts, tool arguments, and file contents to a third party, and the README generally did not
say so. Several were enabled by default. One gate could be reconfigured by the model it was guarding.

This project is the same idea with those failure modes designed out:

| Property | How it is guaranteed here |
|---|---|
| No network call unless you ask for one | Default provider is an offline mock; the live path needs both `provider: live` and a resolved credential |
| Every transmission named before it happens | One startup log line per feature: `off` or `SENDS <feature> { fields }` |
| Gates register nothing when disabled | Verified by test, not by policy — a disabled gate adds no event listener at all |
| The model cannot widen its own constraints | No tool exposes gate configuration |
| A judge that cannot answer never means "allow" | Undecided resolves through explicit config, defaulting to `ask` |

---

## The egress contract

This is the part worth reading before installing.

Transmission is decided per feature, and every feature defaults to off. The plugin prints its own
contract at load:

```
[jevcore] provider=mock  endpoint=none  egress=OFF  (no network calls will be made; every answer is synthetic)
[jevcore] ready - provider=mock - gates: safety=off context=off
```

With `provider: live` and every feature enabled, the same report becomes explicit about what leaves:

```
[jevcore] provider=live  endpoint=https://api.typesafe.ai  egress=ON
[jevcore]   SENDS  tool:jev_ask  { state<=16000c questions<=4000c }
[jevcore]   SENDS  tool:jev_rank  { state<=16000c questions<=4000c }
[jevcore]   SENDS  tool:jev_check  { state<=16000c questions<=4000c }
[jevcore]   SENDS  gate:safety  { state<=8000c questions<=2000c }
[jevcore]   SENDS  gate:context  { state<=6000c questions<=2000c }
[jevcore]   redaction is best-effort; it removes named fields and known secret shapes, and cannot
             recognise an unrecognised secret in free text
```

| Feature | Off by default? | What it sends |
|---|---|---|
| `tool:jev_ask` | runs when the model calls it | the arguments the model passed, after redaction |
| `tool:jev_rank` | runs when the model calls it | the query plus every candidate |
| `tool:jev_check` | runs when the model calls it | the claim and its evidence |
| `gate:safety` | **yes — explicit opt-in** | the tool name, its arguments, the workspace root |
| `gate:context` | **yes — explicit opt-in** | a large tool result the agent just received |

The tools transmit only when the model chooses to call them, which is visible in the transcript. The
gates would run on every matching tool call, which is not, so they are opt-in.

### Redaction, and its honest limit

Before anything is sent, `src/redact.ts` runs two passes: values under sensitive field names
(`password`, `token`, `apiKey`, `authorization`, …) are replaced wholesale, and secret-shaped strings
that survive into free text are pattern-matched (`Bearer …`, `sk-…`, `ts_live_…`, AWS/GitHub/Google
key shapes, JWTs, private-key headers, credentials in connection strings).

This is a mitigation, not a permission. A secret that sits under an unrecognised key name *and* does
not match a known shape will pass through. If that possibility is unacceptable for your workload, do
not enable the live provider.

---

## Install

### As a DeepSeek Harness plugin

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add jevcore-dsh
```

Or from a checkout:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add /absolute/path/to/jevcore/packages/dsh
```

`packages/dsh` imports `jevcore` by name, so a checkout also needs core
resolvable from the profile (`add /absolute/path/to/jevcore/packages/core`).

Then confirm the row activated — the plugin list should show `jev` as `active`,
not `failed` — and check the startup report in the log.

### As an MCP server

For a host that speaks MCP, the same three tools are available over stdio:

```sh
npx -y jevcore-mcp
```

To wire it into DeepSeek Harness specifically, install a configuration-only bundle
whose patch inserts the harness's own MCP client:

```yml
- insert:
    - id: jev-mcp
      name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client'
      config:
        serverName: jev
        transport: stdio
        command: npx
        args: ['-y', 'jevcore-mcp']
        env:
          TYPESAFE_API_KEY: '<the key>'
        failOnStartupError: true
```

The env map is not optional: DSH strips every credential-shaped name — anything
containing KEY, PASSWORD, SECRET or TOKEN, in any case — from the environment it
hands a spawned server, then merges this map back in afterwards. A key exported in
your shell never arrives, and the server stays on the offline mock without
reporting an error.

The provider is chosen from the environment:

| Variable | Effect |
|---|---|
| `TYPESAFE_API_KEY` | Selects the TypeSafe route when present |
| `OPENROUTER_API_KEY` | Selects the OpenRouter route when present and no TypeSafe key is set |
| `JEV_PROVIDER` | `mock`, `live`, or `openrouter` — overrides the heuristic above |
| `TYPESAFE_MODEL` / `OPENROUTER_MODEL` | Model id for the selected route |
| `TYPESAFE_BASE_URL` / `OPENROUTER_BASE_URL` | API root for the selected route |

With neither key it stays on the offline mock. Unlike the plugin, the MCP server
resolves its credential once at startup, so a missing key with
`JEV_PROVIDER=live` is a startup error rather than a per-call surprise.

# dsh-agent-quant-cn

国内市场量化系统的**工具面**：把 CTP 模拟盘的操作暴露成会话内可直接调用的 DSH 工具。 它自己不实现任何策略或连接逻辑——那些在 `projects/self/agent-quant/`（Python 数值层 + JSON CLI）。 本插件只做「工具面 → 取凭据 → CLI → Python」这一层薄转发。 ## 快速开始 **1) 装依赖**（在目标 profile 的 `package.json` 加 link 依赖）： ```jsonc "dsh-agent-quant-cn": "link:E:/alice/self-plugins/dsh-agent-quant-cn" ``` **2) 挂组合**： ```yaml - id: dsh-agent-quant-cn name: dsh-agent-quant-cn ``` **3) 30 秒验证**：`quant_ctp_status` → 应返回模拟盘交易前置登录 + 结算确认 + 资金与持仓 ## 能力（工具） | 工具 | 作用 | 底层 | |---|---|---| | `quant_ctp_status` | CTP 模拟盘体检：交易前置登录 + 结算确认 + 资金与持仓 | `ctp_cli.py ctp_status` | | `quant_ctp_account` | 资金与持仓明细（不做连接体检） | `ctp_cli.py ctp_account` | **故意不提供 `ctp_quote`（行情）**：`mdapi` 在该 CLI 内会段错误（0xC0000005，见任务板 `t-d6ac0958`）。 状态回包里如实披露 `market_data.status = KNOWN_BLOCKER`，不把它包装成一个看起来能用的工具。 行情数据请走回测侧（akshare）。 ## 配置 | 键 | 默认 | 说明 | |---|---|---| | `enabled` | `true` | 只认显式 `false`——未配置视为启用 | | `ctpPython` | `E:\alice\.dsh\venvs\ctp-win\Scripts\python.exe` | **必须**是 Windows 侧 venv | | `ctpCliPath` | `E:\alice\projects\self\agent-quant\scripts\ctp_cli.py` | JSON CLI | | `ctpUser` | `20661` | openctp 公开测试账号（**非密**） | | `ctpBroker` | `9999` | openctp TTS 柜台 | | `vaultScript` | `E:\alice\projects\self\alice-identity\scripts\vault.ps1` | 取值脚本（DPAPI） | | `vaultSite` | `openctp-7x24` | vault 条目名 | | `timeoutMs` | `60000` | 单次调用超时 | ⚠ **路径是锚点不是真源**（AGENTS.md §5.16）：换机、换 venv 位置时改配置，不要改代码。 ## 运行环境 - **CTP 必须跑 Windows venv**（`ctp-win`：Python 3.12 + `openctp-ctp` 6.7.11，已 `openctp-channels switch tts`）。 CTP 预编译库在本机 WSL 上 import 即崩，且 openctp 用的是 TTS 柜台——直接用官方 CTP 库连会报 4097。 - **凭据零落盘**：口令只在「vault 取 → 注入子进程 env → 用完即弃」这条线上存在。 不进配置、不进日志、不进工具返回；错误消息里**只带 stderr，绝不带 stdout**（stdout 是明文）。 取不到时**响亮失败**（空 ≠ 拿到）——空口令冒充成功会让下游以看不出原因的登录失败告终。 ## 生效判据 挂载后在会话里直调 `quant_ctp_status`，应返回真实读数： `ok=true` / `loggedIn=true` / `settled=true`，且 `accounts` 含非空资金字段。 | 症状 | 先看哪里 | |---|---| | `vault 退出码 2` | vault 文件不存在 | | `vault 退出码 3` | DPAPI 解密失败（换用户/换机器即如此） | | `vault 返回空值` | 条目存在但没有 `password` 字段 | | `无法启动解释器` | `ctpPython` 路径腐化 | | `CLI 退出码 6` | 凭据未注入到 CLI（env 变量名对不上） | | `login 3` | 柜台拒绝——用户名或口令不对 | ## 回退 改 `E:\alice\.dsh\profiles\web\cordis.patch.yml`：把该插件行的 `disabled` 置 `true`（配置改动约 2 秒热重载，无需重启）。 ## 边界（不可协商） - **只连模拟盘，不碰真钱**。真实下单必须主人逐次授权，且**不走本插件**。 - 不做策略、不做回测、不下单——这些能力在 Python 层，本插件不复制它们。 ## 测试 ```bash cd self-plugins/dsh-agent-quant-cn && npm test ``` **22 条用例**（跑一次得到）。 ## 相关文档 - [`docs/semantic.md`](docs/semantic.md) —— **权威契约**（定位/反定位 · 验收表） - 中心仓：[alice-digital-life](https://github.com/jonah791/alice-digital-life)

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness bundle: native ctx_* sandbox tools (no MCP child), routing gate, repaired HTTPS fetching, and session context-occupancy reporting.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-mcp-context-mode

> [简体中文](./README.zh.md) | **English**

Give DeepSeek Harness a sandbox it can run code in, a searchable knowledge base it can file things into, and a routing gate that keeps bulk output out of the conversation.

Everything registers as plain `ctx_*` tools in the host process — no child process, no JSON-RPC hop, no `mcp__` prefix in tool names.

## What it is for

A conversation pays for every byte a tool returns, and it keeps paying for the rest of the session. This plugin moves the heavy work off that budget.

A settings page (**Settings → Context mode**, also a card in the Plugins panel) lists every switch this plugin has and shows a live read of the current session: total occupancy, the system / tool-schema / conversation split, the biggest contributors, and this plugin's own savings ledger. A switch that only takes effect at load time is marked as needing a restart instead of pretending it did something.

- **Analyse without reading.** Run code in a sandbox and print only the answer — the raw bytes never enter the conversation.
- **File instead of paste.** Put large material into a local full-text index, then pull back only the matching passages.
- **Fetch without flooding.** Retrieve a page into that index rather than into the transcript.
- **See where the budget went.** Ask for a breakdown of the current session's context occupancy.

## Tools

Ten tools register by default, plus a context report. `ctx_upgrade` exists but ships switched off.

| Tool | What it does |
|---|---|
| `ctx_execute` | Run code in a sandbox (JavaScript, TypeScript, Python, shell). Only what you print comes back. |
| `ctx_execute_file` | Run code over a file, without the file's bytes entering the conversation. |
| `ctx_batch_execute` | Run several commands at once; each output is indexed automatically, and only the sections matching your queries are returned. |
| `ctx_index` | Store content in a local full-text (FTS5) knowledge base. |
| `ctx_search` | Search that knowledge base. Batch several questions into one call. |
| `ctx_fetch_and_index` | Fetch a URL and index it, returning only a small preview. |
| `ctx_stats` | Session savings: bytes kept out of context and what they would have cost. |
| `ctx_doctor` | Self-check: runtimes, storage, SQLite/FTS5, version. |
| `ctx_purge` | Permanently delete indexed content (per session or whole project). |
| `ctx_insight` | Open the companion analytics dashboard in a browser. |
| `ctx_context_report` | Context occupancy for this session: totals, breakdown by category, compaction suggestions, and this plugin's own ledger. Read-only — it replays the session log and makes no model calls. |

Beyond the tools, a **routing gate** watches tool calls before they run: `curl` and `wget` are blocked outright (they paste whole pages into the conversation by design), long commands and oversized file reads get a nudge toward the tools above, and a small allowlist passes through untouched.

## Install

Install straight from the repository:

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:chimneyQ/dsh-mcp-context-mode
```

If pnpm stops with an `ERR_PNPM_IGNORED_BUILDS` message naming two dependencies, answer it with **false** — neither of them needs to compile:

```yaml
# <DSH_HOME>/profiles/desktop/pnpm-workspace.yaml
allowBuilds:
  context-mode: false
  better-sqlite3: false
```

Then run the same command again.

> Answer **false**, not true. This plugin's engine uses Node's built-in `node:sqlite` (present since Node 22.5) and only falls back to the native `better-sqlite3` where that is unavailable. Allowing the build makes pnpm compile `better-sqlite3` from source, which needs a C++ toolchain — on a machine without one it fails and the whole install aborts, leaving no plugin. Nothing needs building in the normal case.

From a local checkout, the same command takes the directory instead:

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile desktop add D:\path\to\dsh-mcp-context-mode
```

Then **restart DeepSeek Harness completely**. The `ctx_*` tools appear in new sessions.

### If the first attempt already failed

The host records the dependency before the build block is answered, and a second `add` on a profile that already lists it takes a different path: pnpm reports "Already up to date", the manifest keeps its entry, and **the plugin is never added to `dsh.profile.bundles` — so it installs but never loads**. Removing the entry first puts the profile back on the normal path:

```powershell
# 1. answer the build block as shown above (keep allowBuilds false)
# 2. drop the half-written dependency
dsh plugin --profile desktop remove dsh-mcp-context-mode
# 3. install again — this time the bundle list is written
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:chimneyQ/dsh-mcp-context-mode
```

Check it took: `dsh.profile.bundles` in `<DSH_HOME>/profiles/desktop/package.json` should list `dsh-mcp-context-mode`.

## Use it well

| Situation | Better than reading it yourself |
|---|---|
| A large log, CSV, or JSON to analyse | `ctx_execute_file` — parse it in the sandbox, print the summary |
| Several commands whose output you need to compare | `ctx_batch_execute` with `queries` — gather and filter in one round trip |
| A long document or page you will quote from | `ctx_fetch_and_index`, then `ctx_search` for the passages |
| Material you may need again later | `ctx_index` once, `ctx_search` on demand |
| Wondering what is filling the context | `ctx_context_report` |

Reading a file in order to **edit** it is the one case where the host's own file tools are still right — they need the exact bytes.

## Configuration

Every adjustable value lives in the plugin's `Config`, so setting it in `cordis.patch.yml` persists:

| Key | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `storageDir` | `''` | Knowledge-base root; empty = `<DSH_HOME>/context-mode` |
| `enginePath` | `''` | Explicit engine entry; empty = resolve automatically |
| `caPemPath` | `'auto'` | TLS trust source: `'auto'` writes a PEM into `storageDir/ca`; an absolute path is used as-is; `''` disables |
| `routing` | `true` | Master switch for the routing gate |
| `denyCurlWget` | `true` | Block `curl`/`wget` outright |
| `bashNudgeMinCommandBytes` | `4096` | Long-command nudge threshold (bytes) |
| `maxReadBytesBeforeAsk` | `51200` | Oversized whole-file read nudge threshold (bytes) |
| `contextReport` | `true` | Register `ctx_context_report` |
| `compressNudgeTokens` | `120000` | Occupancy warning threshold (tokens) |
| `trustedReadBasenames` | 4 names | Filenames exempt from the whole-read nudge |
| `tools.*` | all `true` except `upgrade` | Per-tool switches |

## Verify

The repository ships `SHA256SUMS.txt` describing exactly the bytes it publishes. From the repository root:

```powershell
node -e "const fs=require('fs'),c=require('crypto');for(const l of fs.readFileSync('SHA256SUMS.txt','utf8').split(/\r?\n/)){if(!l.trim()||l.startsWith('#'))continue;const [h,f]=l.split(/\s+/);console.log((c.createHash('sha256').update(fs.readFileSync(f)).digest('hex')===h?'OK  ':'BAD ')+f)}"
```

Offline self-checks. The first needs the dependency installed; the rest are self-contained:

```powershell
npm ci
node smoke.mjs           # 36 assertions: tools, gate, TLS, context report
node test-client.mjs     # 17: the browser half's loader shape and field contract
node test-settings.mjs   #  8: every page control is a volatile Config field
node test-route.mjs      # 17: the settings page's data source, including every degraded path
```

Confirm the profile actually wired the plugin up (an install can leave the dependency recorded while never adding the plugin to `dsh.profile.bundles`, in which case it never loads):

```powershell
node install-check.mjs --profile desktop
```

## Known limits

- The routing gate is **advisory**: where an approval channel exists it asks, and where none exists the call proceeds. It is not a security boundary.
- `tls.setDefaultCACertificates` is a process-wide side effect; set `caPemPath: ''` to turn it off.
- Session restore/distillation is not wired up. For durable notes, use `ctx_index` explicitly.

## License

The plugin code in this repository is MIT (see `LICE

plugins.description: 检查软件物料清单：有没有、全不全、格式对不对、新不新
plugins.readme_text:
# @deepwhale-cn/dsh-sbom

**你的产物里到底有谁，清单说了算。**

**关键词**：软件物料清单 · SBOM · 供应链安全 · CycloneDX · SPDX · 依赖透明 · 行政令 14028 · NTIA 最低要素

---

## 先说清楚它是什么、不是什么

**是**：检查一个项目的 SBOM —— **有没有、全不全、新不新、格式对不对**。
有 lockfile 却一份清单都没有、清单是个空壳、文件名叫 `bom.json` 却不是标准格式、
清单一整年没更新、组件没有 `purl` 唯一标识 —— 这些它都会指出来。

**不是**：
- ❌ **不是 SBOM 生成器** —— 它**不生成**清单，只检查已有的清单（生成是 cyclonedx-npm / syft / spdx-sbom-generator 的活）
- ❌ **不是漏洞扫描器** —— 不查 CVE，那是 `dsh-dep-audit` 的活
- ❌ **不做许可证合规判定** —— 只关心「清单里有没有写清谁是谁」
- ❌ **不下「合规 / 不合规」的结论** —— 只描述事实，判断留给你

**一句话分界**：**别的工具负责写清单，它负责查清单。**

```
dsh-dep-audit  = 查【依赖树】里的漏洞与许可证
dsh-sbom       = 查【物料清单】本身有没有、全不全、新不新
```

---

## 它查什么（5 条）

| 规则 | 查什么 | 级别 |
|---|---|---|
| `SBOM-NO-LIST` | 有 lockfile，却找不到任何 SBOM 文件（absence）| 🔴 |
| `SBOM-EMPTY-SHELL` | SBOM 在，但里面没有任何组件条目 —— 空壳 | 🔴 |
| `SBOM-NOT-STANDARD` | 没有 `bomFormat` / `spdxVersion`，下游工具没法消费 | 🔴 |
| `SBOM-STALE` | SBOM 超过 180 天没更新 | 🟡 |
| `SBOM-NO-IDENTIFIER` | 组件只有名字和版本，没有 `purl` / `CPE` | 🔵 |

**每条都会给出：哪个文件、什么证据、依据是什么、怎么办。**

### 认哪些文件名

`sbom.json` · `bom.json` · `*.cdx.json` · `*.spdx.json` · `*.sbom.json` · `cyclonedx.json` ·
`bom.xml` · `sbom.xml` · `*.cdx.xml` · `*.spdx`（可放在任意子目录）

### 认哪些格式

**CycloneDX**（JSON / XML）· **SPDX**（JSON / tag-value）

### 出处

- 美国行政令 14028《改善国家网络安全》第 4(e) 条
- NTIA《SBOM Minimum Elements》（Components / Component Identifier / Timestamp 等最低要素）
- CycloneDX 规范 / SPDX 规范的官方文档

---

## 安装

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add @deepwhale-cn/dsh-sbom
```

## 用法

```bash
# 检查当前项目
dsh-sbom

# 检查指定目录
dsh-sbom --root /path/to/project

# 看内置演示（一个「有 lockfile、清单却各种残缺」的样本项目）
dsh-sbom --demo

# 列出判据与出处
dsh-sbom --list-rules

# 出 HTML 报告（可截图存档）
dsh-sbom --root /path/to/project --html sbom.html

# 给 CI 用：有 high 命中时退出码 1
dsh-sbom --root . --quiet
```

---

## 一个真实的例子

`--demo` 那个样本项目，看起来挺正常：有 `package.json`、有 `package-lock.json`、有 CI，
`npm run sbom` 脚本也在。仓库里甚至有四份「清单」：

```
sbom.json              导出脚本生成的，但 components 是空的
bom.json               其实是 npm ls --json 导出后改的名
security/bom.xml       内部库存系统导出的 XML，不是 CycloneDX
docs/deps.cdx.json     一年多前导出的老清单，组件没有 purl
```

工具会把它们一条条拎出来：

```
🔴 SBOM 文件里没有组件条目 —— 清单是个空壳        sbom.json / bom.json / security/bom.xml
🔴 SBOM 文件不是标准格式 —— 没有格式标识          bom.json / security/bom.xml
🟡 SBOM 文件超过 180 天没更新                     docs/deps.cdx.json（949 天）
🔵 SBOM 里的组件没有唯一标识（purl / CPE）        docs/deps.cdx.json / sbom.json / …
```

而「有 lockfile 却一份清单都没有」这种项目（`tests/fixtures/absent/minimal`）会报：

```
🔴 有依赖清单却没有物料清单 —— 项目里找不到任何 SBOM 文件
```

**「有清单」和「有一份能用的清单」是两件事**，这个工具查的就是后者。

---

## 边界

- **不生成清单** —— 只检查；生成请用 cyclonedx-npm / syft / spdx-sbom-generator
- **只看清单文件本身** —— 不读产物二进制、不递归进依赖树、不查 CVE
- **不判定合规** —— 报出来是提示确认。清单在发布流水线里临时生成、不进仓库，
  在很多团队是正常做法；工具会照报，需要你自己说明
- **有扫描盲区** —— `dist/` `build/` `node_modules/` 等目录默认跳过，清单若只存在于
  这些目录，会被报成「找不到」；如果清单放在别处且命名不同，也可能漏认
- **时效判断用文件修改时间** —— 如果文件被重新 checkout 过，`SBOM-STALE` 可能不报或误报

---

## 开发

```bash
bash tests/run.sh        # 双向验证：正例全报 + 反例 0 命中
```

> `SBOM-STALE` 看的是**文件修改时间**，而 git 不保存 mtime。如果 `docs/deps.cdx.json`
> 的修改时间被重置（重新 checkout、拷贝目录），这条判据在正例上就报不出来 ——
> `tests/run.sh` 会自动回拨，手动修复用：
> `touch -t 202403110820 tests/fixtures/fail/demo-project/docs/deps.cdx.json`

样本目录（同时是 `--demo` 的数据源，没有第二套）：

```
tests/fixtures/fail/demo-project/     正例：清单空壳 / 非标准格式 / 过期 / 无标识
tests/fixtures/absent/minimal/        正例·absence：有 lockfile、没有任何 SBOM
tests/fixtures/pass/clean-project/    反例：CycloneDX JSON+XML、SPDX JSON 三种格式都合规
```

---


---

## 深鲸网安守护系列（共 31 个）

> 一个插件做一件事。**安全问题是链式的** —— 配套用才完整。

**国内合规** ｜ [等保对照](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-cn-mlps) · [日志留存](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-cn-log-retention) · [备案公示](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-cn-filing) · [用户同意](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-consent-guard) · [个人信息权利](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-data-rights) · [未成年人保护](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-minor-guard) · [影响评估](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-pipia) · [数据分类分级](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-data-classify) · [算法备案](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-algorithm-filing) · [数据出境](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-cn-data-export) · [国密合规](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-cn-crypto) · [AI 内容标识](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-cn-ai-labeling)

**AI 与 Agent 治理** ｜ [AI 输出信任](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-ai-output-trust) · [外部内容信任](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-content-trust) · [MCP 安全](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-mcp-audit) · [Agent 权限](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-agent-scope) · [策略核对](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-agent-policy) · [可疑指令](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-phishing-guard)

**数据与凭据** ｜ [敏感数据](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-data-scan) · [密钥轮换](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-key-rotate) · [数据留存](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-data-lifecycle) · [配置审计](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-env-audit) · [密钥扫描](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-secret-scan)

**供应链与构建** ｜ [开源许可](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-license-guard) · [依赖投毒](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-dep-audit) · [CI 安全](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-ci-guard) · [工具审查](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-tool-vet) · [**物料清单**](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-sbom)

**权限与应急** ｜ [最小权限](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-least-privilege) · [告警外发](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-alert-relay) · [应急证据包](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-incident-package)

都在 DSH 插件市场（dsh-plugin.org）、npm 和 deepwhale.org.cn/guard.html 上。
