plugins.description: Native Rapid-MLX provider for DeepSeek Harness (dsh) — dsh reads model facts from the server instead of your settings.yaml.
plugins.readme_text:
# @raullenchai/dsh-provider

A native [Rapid-MLX](https://github.com/raullenchai/Rapid-MLX) provider for
[DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) — so `dsh`
gets its model facts from the server instead of from whatever you typed into
`settings.yaml`.

[![CI](https://github.com/raullenchai/rapid-mlx-dsh-provider/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/raullenchai/rapid-mlx-dsh-provider/actions/workflows/ci.yml)

> **Status: published to npm** as
> [`@raullenchai/dsh-provider`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@raullenchai/dsh-provider).
> The end-to-end `dsh` run in [Verified](#verified) was on an M3 Ultra against
> `dsh 0.1.0-rc.7`; `dsh 0.1.0-rc.8` is API-compatible — the `LlmAdapter`
> contract is byte-identical and the only changes are additive — and the
> adapter is re-verified against rc.8 at the protocol and unit-test level.
> DSH is still a developer preview that moves fast, so treat this as tracking
> a moving target, not a frozen compatibility promise.

## What it does for you

DSH can already talk to a local Rapid-MLX server through its generic
`openai-completions` provider. That route works — but it knows nothing about
your model beyond what you hand-wrote:

```yaml
# what the generic route makes you maintain, by hand, per model
llm-pi-ai:
  providers:
    rapid-mlx:
      baseURL: http://localhost:8000/v1
      defaultContextWindow: 262144      # you looked this up. is it still right?
      models:
        - id: qwen3.6-35b-8bit
          contextWindow: 262144
          reasoningEfforts: {off: none, low: low, medium: medium, high: high}
```

Rapid-MLX's `/v1/models` already publishes all of that and more. This adapter
reads it, so:

**1. Nothing to hand-write, and nothing to re-write when you switch models.**
Swap what `rapid-mlx serve` is running and `dsh` follows. No re-running setup,
no stale numbers.

**2. The reasoning control tells the truth.** Rapid-MLX reports whether a model
actually has a reasoning parser. A model that can't reason no longer shows an
off/low/medium/high selector that does nothing.

**3. Compaction is timed with the capacity that actually fits this Mac, not a
number that drifted.** This is the one that quietly costs you.
`dsh-compaction-basic` asks the provider for the route's capacity and compacts
at `thresholdRatio × capacity` (0.8 by default). The provider prefers the
server's **`max_model_len`** — Rapid-MLX's memory-fitted ceiling (what fits in
unified memory: weights + KV cache), in the vLLM/SGLang-standard field — over
the native `context_window`, and falls back to `context_window` on an older
server that doesn't report it. So compaction is timed to what the machine can
actually hold, not the model's advertised window (which it may not have room
for) and not a hand-written number copied from another model.

## Install

Needs Node ≥ 22.15 (dsh imports Node's Zstd stream API without declaring it)
and a running Rapid-MLX server.

```sh
# From npm:
dsh plugin --profile web add @raullenchai/dsh-provider

# …or straight from source — the package ships plain JS with no build step:
dsh plugin --profile web add github:raullenchai/rapid-mlx-dsh-provider

export RAPID_MLX_BASE_URL=http://localhost:8000/v1     # optional; this is the default
dsh web
```

Then point the agent at the route:

```yaml
# $DSH_HOME/settings.yaml
agent-default-model:
  provider: rapid-mlx
  model: qwen3.6-35b-8bit
```

Verified: that command installs and activates as a profile layer against
`dsh 0.1.0-rc.7`. To hack on it locally instead, see
[Local development](#local-development).

## Model management (v0.2.0)

Beyond the provider route, the plugin registers five tools and a `/rapid-mlx`
command so the agent can see and manage models without leaving the session.
The split follows which surface actually owns each fact: served-model facts
come from the structured HTTP `/v1/models`; the download cache and pull/remove
are CLI-only, so those — and only those — shell out to `rapid-mlx` through the
harness subprocess seam.

| Tool | Source | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `rapid_mlx_serving` | HTTP `/v1/models` | The model(s) served right now, deduped, with context window, reasoning/tool parsers, MoE/hybrid, and modalities. |
| `rapid_mlx_cached` | `rapid-mlx models --cached` | Downloaded models and their on-disk size. |
| `rapid_mlx_pull` | `rapid-mlx pull <name>` | Download a model (alias or HF repo id). Cancellable; no fixed deadline. |
| `rapid_mlx_remove` | `rapid-mlx rm -y <name>` | Delete a cached model to free disk. |
| `rapid_mlx_health` | HTTP + `rapid-mlx --version` | API up? CLI reachable? Reported as two independent facts. |

`/rapid-mlx` prints a one-shot overview: health, the served model and its facts,
and total cache disk usage.

The CLI is resolved from the `cliCommand` config (default `rapid-mlx` on
`PATH`, or `$RAPID_MLX_CLI`); set it to an absolute path if the binary is not on
the harness's `PATH`. `rapid_mlx_pull`/`rapid_mlx_remove` are the only tools
that change anything on disk, and they run non-interactively (`rm` is forced
with `-y` because the subprocess seam ignores stdin).

## Verified

Against `dsh 0.1.0-rc.7` on an M3 Ultra:

- Installs and **activates as a profile layer** (no "declares no `dsh.bundle`"
  warning; the entry shows up in `dsh --profile headless --dump-config`).
- Registers the `rapid-mlx` route with `ctx.llm` and serves real queries.
- Plain chat, a single tool call, and the multi-step bug-fix task that gates
  Rapid-MLX releases — the last one fixed the bug and made the target repo's own
  test pass, verified independently, in 36 s on `qwen3.6-35b-8bit`.

## Not done yet

Being explicit, because the point of the adapter is to *use* what the server
says and some of it is still only read:

- `recommended_sampling` — should be applied automatically per model.
- `tool_call_parser` — should let `dsh` fail fast on a model that cannot emit
  `tool_calls`, instead of looping.
- `is_hybrid` / `is_moe` / `capabilities` — read, not yet acted on.
- **Memory-aware capacity.** Today `resolveModel()` reports the model's
  *advertised* context window. On a Mac the real ceiling is unified memory, and
  reporting that instead is the biggest remaining win — it needs Rapid-MLX to
  expose a usable-capacity figure first.
- Images are not carried through `stream()` — but they now **refuse** with
  `LlmError(..., 'UNSUPPORTED')` rather than being dropped, per the cookbook.
  Text, reasoning and tool calls are carried.
- The route is registered as `rapid-mlx`. If your `settings.yaml` also declares
  a `rapid-mlx` provider under `llm-pi-ai`, the two compete for one route name
  (`registerAdapter` owns provider exclusivity). Use one or rename ours.

## Conformance with the official adapter contract

Built against
[`docs/cookbook/adding-an-llm-adapter.md`](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/main/docs/cookbook/adding-an-llm-adapter.md)
and its "protocol obligations" section. Each item has a test:

| Obligation | How it is met |
|---|---|
| `usage` before `finish`, nothing after `finish` | usage is buffered and flushed at end-of-stream, so a trailing usage-only chunk cannot reorder it |
| Tool-call `arguments` are raw JSON strings end to end | fragments stream as `argumentsDelta` and reassemble unparsed |
| Block indexes in first-seen order, reused per block | verified across a reasoning-then-text response |
| Errors take exactly two sanctioned paths | transport/protocol failures **throw** `LlmError` with a stable code; nothing ends the stream quietly |
| Honor `options.signal` | passed to `fetch` and to the SSE reader; an `AbortError` is re-thrown unchanged, not reclassified |
| A field the provider cannot honor throws `UNSUPPORTED` | image content refuses instead of being narrowed away |
| Config is a schemastery schema with env fallback | `export const Config`, fed from `cordis.patch.yml` via `!!js process.env.RAPID_MLX_BASE_URL` |

`finish.replayState` is not emitted: Rapid-MLX needs no native response ids
or signatures on follow-up calls, so there is nothing lossless to project.

## Three things worth knowing before you edit this

Each of these cost real

plugins.description: Unofficial DSH plugin bridging Tencent Docs official MCP endpoint (docs.qq.com) · 腾讯文档官方 MCP 桥（社区非官方）
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-tencent-docs-bridge · 腾讯文档 MCP 桥

> **社区 · 非官方** 项目。连接腾讯文档开放平台**官方 MCP 端点**的 DSH 插件，
> 复用官方 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client`，配以完全自足的取票链路
> （扫码 → 本地 vault → 动态挂载）。**仓库零内嵌凭据。**

[![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE)
[![Node](https://img.shields.io/badge/node-%3E%3D22.6-green.svg)](package.json)
[![Topic](https://img.shields.io/badge/topic-dsh--plugin-0e7490.svg)](https://github.com/topics/dsh-plugin)

- [免责声明](DISCLAIMER.md)（安装/使用前必读）
- [合规调研与约束矩阵](COMPLIANCE.md)

---

## 这是什么

DeepSeek Harness（DSH）插件，作用一句话：**让你在 DSH 里直接对腾讯文档说人话**
（"把这张表第 5 行改成 100 并标黄"），底层走腾讯文档官方 MCP。

| 项 | 值 |
|---|---|
| 连接目标 | 腾讯文档开放平台官方 MCP 端点 `https://docs.qq.com/openapi/mcp` |
| 方案 | **方案 A**：复用官方 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client`（streamable-http），插件只做「取票 + 配置注入」 |
| 凭据 | 用户**自己的** space_secret，仅存本地 vault / 环境变量，仓库与配置文件零明文 |
| 官方参考 | [MCP 概述](https://docs.qq.com/open/document/mcp/) · [服务使用须知](https://docs.qq.com/doc/p/ebfba6637ebd4b6b6e0ee20ee890bcbf64d5273a) · [错误码](https://docs.qq.com/open/document/mcp/error-code/) |

---

## ⚠️ 重要声明（务必先读）

1. **非官方**：本项目是社区项目，与腾讯无隶属/授权关系，不使用腾讯商标素材。
2. **自担风险**：所有对官方端点的调用发生在**你的**腾讯账号责任范围内；
   官方频率限制（免费 2000 次/天）由官方执行，本项目不绕过。
3. **凭据安全**：`space_secret` = 你账号的 API 凭据，**只保存在本地**，
   请勿分享；轮换会使旧值立即失效。
4. **不存不传**：本项目**不存储、不传输、不托管**你的文档内容与登录凭据，
   凭据仅存本地 vault / 环境变量，可随时清除。
5. **无担保**：项目按"现状"（AS-IS）提供，作者不对兼容性、可用性做保证。
6. 完整条款见 [DISCLAIMER.md](DISCLAIMER.md)，设计约束见 [COMPLIANCE.md](COMPLIANCE.md)。

---

## 快速开始

### 前置条件

- DSH（DeepSeek Harness）环境，Node.js ≥ 22.6
- 一个腾讯文档账号（支持个人版，QQ/微信登录）
- 官方 mcp-client 包已就位（通常随 profile 自带；如缺：
  `npm i -g @deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client`）

### 安装插件

```bash
# 从 npm（发布后）：
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-tencent-docs-bridge

# 或从 GitHub（推荐提交市场时使用）：
dsh plugin --profile web add github:hs666-ai/dsh-tencent-docs-bridge
```

> 支持 profile：`web`（GUI 桌面）等任意 profile；安装后需重启 `dsh web` 生效。

### 自足取票（第一步：准备凭据）

插件**不内置任何 token**。你需要先拿到自己账号的 `space_secret`（32 位 hex）：

**方式 1（推荐，完全自足）—— 用本插件自带 CLI：**
```bash
# 1) 在浏览器登录 https://docs.qq.com/desktop/ （微信/QQ 扫码）
# 2) 从登录态获取 space_secret，写入本地 vault：
npx tdoc-auth inject --token <32位hex>
# 3) 验证：
npx tdoc-auth probe
```
> `space_secret` 获取细节见 [docs/SELF-SERVE.md](docs/SELF-SERVE.md)
> （含 create_secret 接口说明——这是 docs.qq.com 官方登录态下的标准取票口）。

**方式 2 —— 环境变量：**
```bash
export TDOC_OAUTH_ACCESS_TOKEN=<32位hex>
```

**方式 3 —— 本地网关：** 若你已在 127.0.0.1:18761 跑了一个兼容
`/internal/tencent-docs/tokens` 的网关，插件启动时也会从那里取。

### 重启并验证

重启 `dsh web` 后，插件会自动把官方 mcp-client 挂上（`serverName=tencent-docs`）。
工具以 `mcp__tencent-docs__*` 出现，例如：

- `mcp__tencent-docs__get_sheet_info`
- `mcp__tencent-docs__set_cell_value`
- `mcp__tencent-docs__manage_search_file`
- …

对模型说一句"列出我最近的腾讯文档"即可验证。

---

## 工作方式（方案 A 细节）

```
┌──────────────┐   loader.create    ┌──────────────────────┐   HTTP/JSON-RPC   ┌────────────────────┐
│ dsh 插件入口  │ ─────────────────▶ │ @deepseek-ai/         │ ────────────────▶ │ docs.qq.com        │
│ lib/index.js │   (动态挂载，        │ dsh-mcp-client        │   Bearer          │ /openapi/mcp 官方  │
│              │    token 来自 vault)│ (streamable-http)     │   space_secret    │ MCP 端点           │
└──────┬───────┘                     └──────────────────────┘                   └────────────────────┘
       │
       ▼ 取票链（见 lib/resolver.js）
 env TDOC_OAUTH_ACCESS_TOKEN  →  本地 vault.json  →  本地网关 127.0.0.1:18761
```

| 文件 | 职责 |
|---|---|
| `lib/index.js` | 插件入口：启动时取票 → `ctx.loader.create` 挂载官方 mcp-client |
| `lib/resolver.js` | 取票链：env > vault > 本地网关（兼容） |
| `lib/vault.js` | 本地凭据箱：读写 + 权限收紧 + 脱敏指纹 |
| `lib/mcp.js` | 端点定义唯一来源 + mcp-client config 构造（两种模式共用） |
| `bin/tdoc-auth.mjs` | 取票 CLI：inject / probe / status / clear |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | 把插件自身插入 profile 层（mcp 条目由运行时挂载，绝无明文） |

---

## Declarative 模式（可选）

如果你**不想用运行时挂载**，也可以自己把手动 mcp-client 条目贴在
profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml`，token 走环境变量（**不要贴明文**）：

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: mcp-tencent-docs
      name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client'
      config:
        serverName: tencent-docs
        transport: streamable-http
        url: https://docs.qq.com/openapi/mcp
        headers:
          Authorization: !!js `Bearer ${process.env.TDOC_OAUTH_ACCESS_TOKEN}`
        toolCallTimeoutMs: 60000
```

然后用 `--disable-runtime-mount` 启动插件（或直接从 profile 移除本插件，只留上方条目也行）。

---

## 安全设计（COMPLIANCE.md §4 的落地）

- ✅ 仓库、cordis.patch.yml、README 中**零 token 明文**（CI 有检查，见下）
- ✅ token 只存在：本地 vault（权限 0600 / Windows ACL 收紧）+ 进程内存 + 发往官方端点的请求头
- ✅ 日志只输出「长度+前 4 位」指纹（`len32:83ca…`），绝无完整 token
- ✅ 模型只见 MCP 工具结果（业务数据），不见 token
- ✅ 卸载 = 本文档 + `npx tdoc-auth clear` 清空 vault，即完全断连
- ✅ `npx tdoc-auth status` 可随时查看 vault 摘要（无明文）

## 开发 / 测试

```bash
npm run check      # typecheck + test（沙箱内可用 node tests/*.mjs 单跑）
```

## 本地验证记录（v0.1.0 装机实测）

在 DeepSeek Harness v0.2.0-rc.2 上做过**真实装机验证**（独立 profile，测完即卸）：

| 验证项 | 结果 |
|---|---|
| `dsh plugin add` 本地 tgz 安装 | ✅ exit 0 |
| `--dump-config` 合成树含 `- id: dsh-tencent-docs-bridge` | ✅ |
| 插件入口模块加载（`import()`） | ✅ `OK exports: name,apply` |
| boot 宿主加载 | ✅ 无 `failed to import`（修复前会报 `warning: entry did not activate`） |
| 测试 / 防泄露扫描 | ✅ 18/18 单测 + 零硬编码凭据 |

**现场状态（desktop profile 真实装机）**：

![插件在 DSH 中已启用并运行中](assets/screenshot-plugin-status.png)

> 上图为 0.1.0 安装在 desktop profile 后的 DSH「内置插件」面板：插件
> 已启用、运行中（真实环境截图，非 mock）。

> 曾发现并修复一个加载兼容性问题：插件入口顶层 `import '@deepseek-ai/cordis'`
> 会导致真实宿主 `failed to import`（cordis 为宿主注入的 peer dep，插件自身
> node_modules 中解析不到）。已改为官方同款 `apply(ctx)` 模式，运行时不依赖
> cordis 模块解析。发布前防泄露检查见 [docs/RELEASE.md](docs/RELEASE.md)。

## 发布（维护者）

1. 建独立 GitHub 仓库，打 `dsh-plugin` topic（市场自动收录）
2. `npm publish`
3. 更新 [docs/RELEASE.md](docs/RELEASE.md)

---

## 许可与合规

- 代码：[MIT](LICENSE)
- 免责：[DISCLAIMER.md](DISCLAIMER.md)
- 合规基线：[COMPLIANCE.md](COMPLIANCE.md)（含官方条款出处、Do/Don't、泄露防护清单）

**本插件独立于腾讯文档官方发布；"腾讯文档"为腾讯公司商标，仅用于客观指称其官方产品。**

# dsh-persona-studio · 人格编译工坊

> 给 DeepSeek Harness 装一间「人格车间」：把 LLM 的**对话风格、创作习惯、反馈方式、语气语调**编译成一份可版本化、可预览、可复用的规格；
> 可以直接调用内置/自定义人格模板，也可以让它**读你过往的对话记录、归纳你的潜在需求**，自动生成人格并形成稳定的协作倾向。
> 对应的 UI 就挂在主界面（输入框工具栏 / 右下角悬浮按钮），不需要离开对话。

> **注意：本插件原名 `dsh-persona-forge`，现已改名为 `dsh-persona-studio`。**
> 原因：原名与 npm 上已有的一个插件撞名（那个是"改写你发出的消息"，与本插件"配置助手人格"不是一回事）。
> 改名后需要**重启一次 DSH** 才能生效 —— 正在运行的宿主仍然认得旧名字。
> 数据目录没有跟着改（仍是 `$DSH_HOME/persona/`），你的人格库不会因为改名而丢。

**English summary** — Compile an LLM persona inside DeepSeek Harness from six dimensions
(identity, tone, creative habits, feedback style, boundaries, run parameters), preview the compiled
text live, and inject it at the end of the system prompt. Ships six built-in templates plus a
drop-in templates folder, and drafts a persona from your own past messages — either by counting
patterns or by having the current model read them and report its rationale. Zero dependencies,
zero build step; the loader half is plain ESM and the browser half is plain JavaScript served
over the plugin's own HTTP route. Adds a panel next to the composer and a `/persona` command.

---

## 1. 它解决什么问题

普通人调「人格」的方式是写一段系统提示词 —— 不可复用、不可对比、改坏了不知道。
这个插件把人格拆成**六个维度、41 个字段**，每个字段都有明确的语义与刻度，然后编译成一段确定性的提示词：

| 维度 | 回答的问题 | 典型字段 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 身份设定 | 你是谁、怎么称呼我 | 人格名、头衔、称呼、自称、一句话定位 |
| 对话风格 · 语气语调 | 怎么说 | 语气基调、篇幅倾向、热情度、正式度、直接程度、幽默感、emoji、比喻、标点风格、口头禅、禁用表达、语言偏好 |
| 创作习惯 | 怎么干活 | 动手前规划、回答结构、探索↔实现、验证习惯、注释与命名、交付形态、主动程度、风险偏好、自定义习惯 |
| 反馈方式 | 怎么回应我 | 不确定时怎么办、怎么指出问题、建议颗粒度、肯定频率、追问策略、过程汇报、自己犯错时、自定义规则 |
| 边界与红线 | 什么绝不让步 | 必须始终做到、绝对不做、补充说明 |
| 运行参数 | 工程细节 | temperature、开头是否重复强化、聚焦等级 |

「**聚焦等级**」是这个插件最重要的一个开关：

- `strict` —— 风格是强制约束，除非与安全/事实/你当次的显式指令冲突；
- `balanced`（默认）—— 风格只管「怎么说、怎么组织、怎么推进」，**不改变任务事实与你的显式指令**，冲突时以你的指令为准；
- `off` —— 本次不注入人格。

---

## 2. 三个核心能力

### ① 编译人格（可预览、可回滚）

「编译」标签页左边是表单、右边是**实时编译结果**——改一个刻度，右边立刻显示将被注入系统提示词的最后那段文本（用 `<persona>…</persona>` 包裹，落在 `DEPLOYMENT_PERSONA_SUFFIX` 之后，即整个系统提示词的收尾处）。
保存即生效：下一次模型请求就会带上新人格，不需要重启、不需要重开对话。

### ② 调用现成模板

- **内置 6 套**：严谨工程师、系统架构师、苏格拉底导师、中文文字匠、极简执行者、结对编程搭子；
- **自定义模板文件**：把 `*.json` 丢进 `<人格库目录>/templates/` 即可出现在「模板」页里。格式：

  ```json
  {
    "name": "我的搭子",
    "tags": ["私有"],
    "summary": "一句话说明",
    "spec": { "style": { "tone": "casual", "directness": 90 } }
  }
  ```

  只写想覆盖的字段即可，其余走默认值。也可以直接是一份裸 spec。
- 导出/导入：`GET /dsh-persona-studio/export` 会下载完整的人格库 JSON（含配置与激活记录），可跨机器迁移。

### ③ 从历史对话自动归纳

「自动归纳」页有两种模式：

- **统计归纳（默认，零成本）**：读取最近若干在线会话里"你说的话"，统计消息长度分布、列表/代码块占比、祈使句比例、礼貌用语、emoji、语气强度、报错语境、规划语境等，
  把它们映射成一份人格草案，并给出**判断依据**与**潜在需求**（例如"反复出现报错语境 → 要求跑命令验证 + 按严重度列问题"）。
- **模型深读（消耗额度，更细腻）**：复用**你当前会话正在使用的模型**（自动捕获路由，无需配置），把对话样本交给它归纳，
  要求它输出人格 JSON + 依据 + 你**没说出口但反复出现的需求**；失败会自动回落到统计归纳并说明原因。

归纳结果可以「采纳并启用」，也可以先丢进编译器里改。每次采纳/切换都会写进 `traces.jsonl`（倾向轨迹），在「设置」页可以看到最近记录。

---

## 3. 界面在哪里

面板默认挂在**输入框工具栏右侧**（`conversation.input.right` 那一簇，和模型选择器同一行）。
锚点是宿主客户端 bundle 里的稳定契约，不是猜的：

```
[data-composer-seat]                     ← 输入区外层
  └ .<hash>_composerStack
      └ [data-composer-card]             ← 输入卡片
          ├ [data-composer-input]        ← 可编辑输入框
          └ .<hash>_row                  ← 底部工具栏行
              ├ .<hash>_tools            ← 左簇（附件/命令/权限/计划）
              └ .<hash>_trailing         ← 右簇（模型选择/发送）★ 默认挂这里
```

CSS module 的哈希前缀（如 `Dc7zOa_`）会随构建变化，所以只按 `_trailing` / `_tools`
后缀匹配，不硬编码前缀；找不到锚点时自动降级为右下角悬浮，**不会消失**。

| 位置 | 内容 |
| --- | --- |
| 输入框工具栏右侧（默认） | 「人格」圆形按钮：显示当前人格名，点开即面板 |
| 面板 · 人格库 | 卡片列表，一键「使用 / 编辑 / 复制 / 删除」 |
| 面板 · 模板 | 内置与文件模板，一键实例化 |
| 面板 · 编译 | 六维度表单 + 实时编译预览 + 保存并启用 |
| 面板 · 自动归纳 | 统计归纳 / 模型深读、依据与潜在需求、采纳 |
| 面板 · 设置 | 挂载位置、全局注入开关、归纳会话数上限、紧凑模式、数据路径、导出、倾向轨迹 |
| 对话内 | `/persona`、`/persona list`、`/persona use <名称或ID>`、`/persona on|off`、`/persona path` |

挂载位置可在「设置」页切换（右侧工具栏 / 左侧工具栏 / 输入卡片旁 / 右下角悬浮），
选择会写进 `config.json` 并在重启后保持。快捷键：`Ctrl+Shift+P` 开合面板，`Esc` 关闭。

浏览器控制台里还有自检入口：`__DSH_PERSONA_FORGE_API__.remount() / .placement() / .state()`。

---

## 4. 安装

### 方式 A：脚本（推荐）

```powershell
# Windows
pwsh -File scripts/install.ps1                  # 默认 profile = desktop
pwsh -File scripts/install.ps1 -Profile web     # 指定 profile
```

```bash
# macOS / Linux
bash scripts/install.sh desktop
```

脚本做三件事（幂等）：在 `<profile>/node_modules` 建目录联接、在 `package.json` 登记依赖与 bundle、在 `cordis.patch.yml` 插入挂载行。
**改完必须重启一次 DSH**（bundle 列表在启动时解析）。

### 方式 B：手动

1. 把本目录放到任意位置，并在 profile 的 `node_modules` 下建一个指向它的联接（Windows 用 junction）；
2. `<profile>/package.json`：
   ```json
   "dependencies": { "dsh-persona-studio": "0.1.0" },
   "dsh": { "profile": { "bundles": ["…", "dsh-persona-studio"] } }
   ```
3. `<profile>/cordis.patch.yml` 末尾追加：
   ```yaml
   - insert:
       - id: dsh-persona-studio
         name: dsh-persona-studio
   ```
4. 重启 DSH。

### 验证

```powershell
# 宿主路由应该返回 JSON
Invoke-WebRequest http://127.0.0.1:19387/dsh-persona-studio/state -UseBasicParsing
# 页面里应能看到 injected 的 bootstrap 脚本
(Invoke-WebRequest http://127.0.0.1:19387/ -UseBasicParsing).Content -match 'dsh-persona/bootstrap.js'
```

### 卸载

```powershell
pwsh -File scripts/uninstall.ps1                 # 保留人格库数据
pwsh -File scripts/uninstall.ps1 -RemoveData     # 连数据一起删
```

---

## 5. 数据放在哪

全部在 `$DSH_HOME/persona/`（默认 `~/.dsh/persona/`），升级 DSH 不会丢：

| 文件 | 内容 |
| --- | --- |
| `library.json` | 人格库 + 当前激活人格 |
| `config.json` | 注入开关、归纳参数等运行配置 |
| `templates/*.json` | 你放进去的自定义模板 |
| `compiled.txt` | 当前人格编译出的提示词快照（便于查看/交接） |
| `traces.jsonl` | 激活/采纳/删除记录（倾向轨迹） |

---

## 6. 自检

不启动 DSH 也能跑（用自带的 Node 即可）：

```powershell
node test/smoke.mjs     # 规格/编译/归纳/HTTP/损坏保护/送达自检/BOM 卫生（44 项）
node test/apply.mjs     # 宿主接线：section 注册、路由表、注入行、命令、损坏拒绝、模型兜底（14 项）
node test/panel.mjs     # 面板 UI：挂载、回退、预览联动、编辑保持、损坏警告（26 项）
```

`test/panel.mjs` 用最小 DOM 桩在 Node 里真实执行 `assets/panel.js`，并且**复刻了宿主真实的
输入区结构**（`[data-composer-seat] > _composerStack > [data-composer-card] > _row > _trailing`），
所以"按钮挂在输入框工具栏右侧""锚点缺失时降级到悬浮""切换位置立即重挂并落盘"
"改参数预览跟着变""离开编译页回来不丢编辑""数据坏了会警告"这些行为不需要开浏览器就能回归验证。

其中 `/preview` 的测试桩**用真实编译器编译请求里的规格**，所以"预览随编辑变化"是被真验证的，
而不是固定返回同一段文字 —— 这一点曾经让测试漏掉了"预览不更新"的真实 bug，已修正。

三个测试脚本在**断言失败时都会以非零退出码结束**，并且都接得住异步检查里的失败\n（`apply.mjs` / `smoke.mjs` 曾经漏了这两条：失败既不计数也不改退出码，\n汇总行还会打印"全部通过" —— 这类"绿着失败"的测试比没有测试更危险，已修）。

## 7. 数据安全

人格库和配置都在 `$DSH_HOME/persona/` 下，是本插件的"家底"。做了这几层保护：

| 保护 | 行为 |
| --- | --- |
| 原子写入 | 先写临时文件再 `rename`，中途断电/崩溃不会留下半份文件 |
| 损坏检测 | 读取时区分"文件不存在"和"内容坏了"，不再一律当成空 |
| **拒绝覆盖** | 文件内容坏了时，**所有写操作整体被拒绝**（不是"改一半"），避免用一份空数据把你的人格抹掉 |
| 保留原件 | 恢复动作不会删除坏文件，而是改名成 `xxx.json.corrupt-<时间>` 存着 |
| 界面可见 | 损坏时设置页顶部出现红色警告，点名是哪个文件、什么错、并提供恢复按钮 |
| 逃生口 | 警告里的「备份坏文件并重建」＝先备份再写默认值，坏文件始终留着 |

> 为什么值得做：以前的实现把"读失败"和"文件不存在"一起处理，
> 结果是**坏文件会在下一次保存时被默认值静默覆盖**。现在这条路径被堵住了。

### 已修复的重要 bug（留作前车之鉴）

| 现象 | 根因 |
| --- | --- |
| 改参数预览不变 / 离开编译页编辑被重置 / 保存后人格库不变 | `describeSpec()` 漏给字段带 `section`，前端把修改全写进 `spec.undefined`。**同一个根因导致三个现象** |
| 命令行发中文请求被拒（400） | 人格编号含中文，终端二次编码损坏。现在编号纯 ASCII，保存旧编号会自动升级 |
| 面板被输入框或聊天内容挡住 | 面板相对工具栏定位，锚点容器若有 transform 会成为包含块。现在按钮与面板都用视口坐标定位，并自动决定向上/向下展开 |
| 在编译页待久了回不到其他页签 | 表单变长后页签栏被滚走。现在页签吸顶 |
| **插件完全不加载（连报错都很少）** | `package.json` / `cordis.patch.yml` 开头被写入了 **BOM**（不可见字符），JSON 直接解析失败 |
| **安装脚本运行到一半报"缺少 Text 参数"** | PowerShell 的管道输出不会自动绑到普通函数的参数上，须先收进变量再按名字传 |
| **`.ps1` 脚本里的中文变乱码、语法坏掉** | 脚本自身缺 UTF-8 BOM，PowerShell 5.1 按 ANSI 读取 |

### BOM 这件事的结论（值得记住）

同一个「BOM」在两类文件上要求**正好相反**，测试里按扩展名分开钉住：

| 文件 | 要不要 BOM | 为什么 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `package.json`、`cordis.patch.yml`、`.js` / `.mjs` / `.css` / `.md` | **绝不能有** | `JSON.parse` 会把 BOM 当非法字符直接抛错 |
| `.ps1`（PowerShell 脚本） | **必须有** | PowerShell 5.1 没有 BOM 时按 ANSI 读，中文注释会变乱码并破坏语法 |

配套规则：写 profile 的配置文件**只能用** `Write-Utf8NoBom`（脚本内已提供），
不能用 `Set-Content -Encoding UTF8` —— 后者在 PowerShell 5.1 下会加 BOM。

---

## 8. 设计约束（为什么它不会「越权」）

- 人格只注入**提示词**，不修改任何工具行为、权限或沙箱策略；
- `balanced` 下人格永远让位于你的显式指令与任务事实；
- 路由只监听本机回环，且拒绝 `Sec-Fetch-Site: cross-site` 与跨源 `Origin`；
- 所有写入都是「临时文件 + 原子重命名」；文件损坏时**拒绝覆盖**而不是默默回落；
- 前端面板是纯 DOM + 前缀类名（`.dpf-`），不依赖任何构建产物，改完刷新页面即生效。

## 9. 许可

MIT

plugins.description: Ship a local DSH plugin project to GitHub and the plugin market in one call: preflight, per-file upload with byte verification, the market registry PR, then pull every published file back and compare bytes.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-slipway（滑道）

**把本地 DSH 插件工程一条命令发到 GitHub、再开一条市场收录 PR，最后把线上文件逐个拉回来比 sha256。**

> 名字的来由：船造好了得从滑道下水。前面三个作品每发一次，我都要手写同一串脚本 ——
> 建仓库 → 逐文件 PUT（还要比字节数）→ 打 topic → fork 建分支 → 写登记 yml → 开 PR →
> 线上逐文件回拉核对。三遍下来每次都掉同一个坑。这活该由代码干。

---

## 它做什么

一次调用走完四个阶段，每个阶段都留下可核对的证据：

| 阶段 | 做什么 | 证据 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **① 自检** | 读 `package.json`、按 `files` 白名单收集文件、查 `main`/`exports`/`dsh.bundle.patch` 是否落地、扫密钥 | 文件数、总字节、错误/提醒清单 |
| **② 仓库** | 有就复用、没有就建（`auto_init:false`） | 仓库 URL、默认分支 |
| **③ 上传** | 逐文件 PUT（带 sha 的更新式写入），然后设 topics | 每个文件的字节数与 blob 短 sha |
| **④ 市场 PR** | fork（若无）→ 从上游 head 建分支 → 写 `data/plugins/<owner>__<repo>.yml` → 开 PR | PR 号与状态（已有 PR 就报它的号，不重复开） |
| **⑤ 回验** | 把线上每个文件拉回来，与本地比 **sha256 与长度** | 「N 个文件线上字节与本地完全一致」 |

## 安全边界（代码里的边界，不是口头承诺）

- **默认 dry-run**：不显式传 `dryRun: false`（CLI 是 `--go`）就只演算、只报告，**一根手指都不动远端**。
- **目标必须显式给**：`projectDir`（绝对路径）/ `repo` / `category` / `descriptionEn` / `descriptionZh` 缺一不可。
  解析不出来就**报错**，绝不从当前目录、包名或相似度去猜。
- **owner 与 token 必须对得上**：token 属于别人 —— 直接停，不做任何请求。
- **token 永不进输出**：只出现 `ghp_****(40)` 这样的掩码；请求证据里只记方法与路径，**不记 body**。
- **密钥扫描在自检里**：命中 `sk-…` / `ghp_…` / 私钥块等即**阻断发布**，且只报文件:行号与掩码，**不回显明文**。
- **幂等**：仓库、分支、PR 都先查再说；重复跑不会造出第二条。
- **活代码树警告**：工程若被 profile 的 junction 挂载（即"活代码"），报告里会出现 `live-tree` 提醒 ——
  **发布可以，测试绝对不许在那里跑**（把副本复制到沙箱再跑）。

## 安装

市场收录后：在 DSH 里搜 `dsh-slipway` 安装即可。手动安装：

```powershell
# 1) 建目录链接（junction 不需要管理员）
New-Item -ItemType Junction -Path "$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\profiles\desktop\node_modules\dsh-slipway" -Target "D:\dsh\projects\dsh-slipway"
# 2) profile 的 package.json：dependencies 加 "dsh-slipway": "link:D:/dsh/projects/dsh-slipway"
#    **同时**加进 dsh.profile.bundles（漏了就不加载）
# 3) 重启 DSH
```

## 用法

### 作为工具（Agent 用）

```
slipway_publish   projectDir=… repo=… category=tools descriptionEn=… descriptionZh=… [dryRun]
slipway_verify    projectDir=… repo=… owner=…
```

典型流程：先 `dryRun` 跑一次 → 把报告给人看 → 得到许可 → `dryRun: false`。

### 作为命令（不开会话也能发）

```powershell
# 只自检（只读）
dsh-slipway plan    --project D:\dsh\projects\dsh-slipway --repo dsh-slipway --category tools --desc-en "…" --desc-zh "…"

# dry-run（默认）
dsh-slipway publish --project … --repo … --category tools --desc-en "…" --desc-zh "…"

# 真跑
dsh-slipway publish --project … --repo … --category tools --desc-en "…" --desc-zh "…" --go

# 只回验
dsh-slipway verify  --project … --repo … --owner 7gzgn
```

退出码：`0` 成功 / `0` dry-run 通过；`1` 有阻断；`2` 用法错误。

### PAT 从哪来

依次找：`--token-file` → 环境变量 `DSH_SLIPWAY_TOKEN_FILE` → `~/.dsh/.gh-token` → `D:\dsh\.gh-token`。
需要的 scope：`repo`（建仓库、推文件、开 PR）。

### 市场分类白名单

`agi ui usage theme model identity session memory tools wsl browser vision voice docs skill workflow git notify dev security remote market fun`

## 兼容性

- 运行时：**DSH 0.2.0-rc.2**（本人实测使用的版本）。
- `peerDependencies` 用显式范围（`>=0.2.0-rc.2 <0.3.0-0`），下限是实测过的版本，上限不赌没验证过的 breaking change。
- **运行时主动降级**：拿不到 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools` 的 `defineTool` → 退化成恒等函数（CLI 与测试场景照常工作）；
  `ctx.systemPrompt` 不存在 → 跳过公告段。宿主 API 有出入时，本插件少一项能力，而不是把 DSH 拖崩。

## 已知边界

- **单文件 ≤ 25MB**：contents API 走不了更大的文件（那需要 Git Data API，v0.1 不做）；>1MB 会给提醒。
- **不做 npm 发布**：DSH 市场大半靠 `github:owner/repo` 安装，npm 不在链路上。
- **不替你跑项目的测试**：测试要不要跑、在哪跑由调用方决定（活代码树里跑测试 = 在真宿主上生效，这是血换来的规矩）。
- **不自动写简介**：市场条目上的中英文简介必须由人给 —— 自动生成的是"看起来像"的话。

## 自测

```powershell
node test/smoke.mjs   # 56 项，全用假 GitHub，不碰网络、不碰宿主
```

测试开头有一道**活代码树自检**：发现自己在 `profiles/*/node_modules` 挂着的工程里跑，就直接 `exit 2`。

## License

MIT

plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-feishu

English | [中文](README.zh.md)

Deep **Feishu / Lark** integration for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness).

It gives the agent eight tools that act on a real Feishu tenant (and a browser
panel that shows what it did and fixes authorization in one click):

| Tool | What it does |
|---|---|
| `feishu_bitable` | Create **Bitable (多维表格)** apps with their tables and fields in one call; list tables and fields; insert, search, update, and delete records in batches |
| `feishu_dashboard` | Create dashboards and **chart blocks** inside a Bitable (柱状图 / 折线图 / 饼图 / 排行榜 / 指标卡 / NPS … 15 types), position them, and read a chart's computed numbers |
| `feishu_query` | Run a **grouped, aggregated query** over a table (group by, sum / avg / min / max / count / distinct_count, filter, sort, top-N) with the aggregation done server-side |
| `feishu_doc` | Create documents; append Markdown (converted to native blocks), append raw blocks, read plain text, or import a local Markdown/Word/Excel/PowerPoint/PDF file as a new cloud document |
| `feishu_sheet` | Create spreadsheets; add sheets; read, write, and append ranges |
| `feishu_drive` | Browse folders, create folders, upload and download files, move, delete, read metadata |
| `feishu_wiki` | List wiki spaces and nodes, resolve a wiki token to its document, create and move nodes |
| `feishu_message` | Send text, interactive cards, rich posts, files, and images; reply in a thread; post through a custom-bot webhook |
| `feishu_auth` | Diagnose authorization, produce the authorization URL, complete a manual code exchange, refresh, and log out |
| `feishu_api` | Call any documented Feishu open-platform path, with the same auth, retry, and error mapping |

New content lands in **the user's own cloud drive** because the tools act as the
authorized user, not as the app. When no user grant is stored they fall back to
the app identity and say so in a warning rather than silently filing documents
into a space the user cannot see.

---

## Quick start

### 1. Create a Feishu app

1. Open the [Feishu Open Platform](https://open.feishu.cn/app) (or
   [Lark](https://open.larksuite.com/app)) and create a **custom app**.
2. Under **凭证与基础信息**, note the **App ID** and **App Secret**.
3. Under **安全设置 → 重定向 URL**, add the callback this plugin serves:

   ```
   http://127.0.0.1:19387/api/feishu/oauth/callback
   ```

   The port is whatever DeepSeek Harness serves on (the plugin reads it from the
   host and reports the exact URI in `feishu_auth` action `status`).
4. Under **权限管理**, add the scopes below, then **publish a version** — scopes
   only apply after the version is released:

   | Scope | Needed for |
   |---|---|
   | `offline_access` | **Required** — without it Feishu returns no refresh token and the user must re-authorize every couple of hours |
   | `bitable:app` | Bitable |
   | `docx:document` | Documents |
   | `drive:drive` | Drive, imports, uploads |
   | `sheets:spreadsheet` | Spreadsheets |
   | `wiki:wiki` | Wiki |
   | `im:message`, `im:resource` | Messages and file/image sending |
   | `contact:user.base:readonly` | Reading the authorized user's name |

### 2. Enable the plugin

See [Install](#install) below, then restart DeepSeek Harness.

### 3. Configure it in the GUI

Open **设置 → 飞书 / Feishu**. Everything is editable there — no YAML by hand:

- **应用凭据** — the App ID, the App Secret (write-only), the credential
  reference name, and the brand (飞书 / Lark).
- **默认落点与身份** — the folder new content lands in, and which identity the
  tools use by default.
- **功能开关** — whether the tools register, whether the HTTP routes mount,
  whether the floating panel shows, and the tool-name prefix.
- **授权** — the scopes to request and the redirect URL to register.
- **高级** — endpoint overrides and the page-size caps.

**Saving writes only this plugin's entry** in the profile's `cordis.patch.yml`,
which the harness hot-reloads, so most changes apply without a restart. The App
Secret is *never* written to that file: it goes straight into the credential
store under the reference name, and the page only ever shows whether it is set.

### 4. Authorize

Press **授权飞书** on the settings page, or ask the agent to run `feishu_auth`
with action `authorize_url`. The browser lands on the callback, the grant is
stored, and every later call acts as that user. The same form shows the redirect
URL to register on the Feishu app and lists the scopes to grant.

> Host without a reachable browser callback (a remote or headless session)? Open
> the URL anywhere, then pass the `code` query parameter to `feishu_auth` with
> action `complete`.

---

## Install

Two ways, and they are alternatives — **do not do both.** Each creates a loader
entry with id `feishu`, and the loader rejects a composition that defines one id
twice with `duplicate loader entry id`.

### As a bundle (recommended)

The package declares a `dsh.bundle` patch, so a bundle-aware CLI installs and
mounts it in one step:

```sh
dsh plugin add github:2048lr/dsh-feishu
```

That appends `dsh-feishu` to `dsh.profile.bundles` and profile boot merges
[cordis.patch.yml](cordis.patch.yml), which inserts the plugin row. Nothing else
needs editing.

The settings page is aware of this: when the profile mounts the bundle, it writes
an **id-targeted config override** rather than a second `insert`, so saving from
the GUI never breaks the composition.

### By hand (no CLI)

The plugin must be resolvable from the profile's `node_modules`, so it is copied
there:

```powershell
# from the repository root
pwsh -File scripts/install.ps1
```

The script copies the package into the profile's `node_modules` and inserts the
entry into `cordis.patch.yml`:

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: feishu
      name: dsh-feishu
      config:
        appId: cli_xxxxxxxxxxxx
        # appSecretRef: FEISHU_APP_SECRET
        # brand: feishu          # or lark
        # defaultFolderToken: fldcnxxxxxxxx
```

**Restart DeepSeek Harness.** The host half is a Node module cached in-process,
so a reload alone does not pick it up. The browser half reloads with the page.

After that first restart, use **设置 → 飞书 / Feishu** instead of editing the YAML:
the page rewrites the block the installer added and the harness hot-reloads it.

### Why the package avoids `@deepseek-ai/*` imports

A third-party plugin is loaded from a junction or a copied directory inside the
profile, where a bare `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools` specifier resolves to whichever
DSH installation is reachable — which may not be the running host. The host half
therefore imports **only Node builtins** and hand-writes its tool definitions
and its configuration validation. The test suite checks every generated schema
against the real SDK validator, so the hand-written form cannot drift from what
the registry accepts.

---

## Configuration

All fields are optional except `appId`.

| Field | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `appId` | — | The Feishu app id. Required. |
| `appSecretRef` | `FEISHU_APP_SECRET` | Credential reference resolved through the harness credential store, then the environment. |
| `appSecret` | `''` | Literal fallback. Discouraged: it puts a secret in configuration. |
| `brand` | `feishu` | `feishu` (open.feishu.cn) or `lark` (open.larksuite.com). |
| `apiBaseUrl` / `accountsBaseUrl` | per brand | Override the endpoints (for a proxy or a private gateway). |
| `defaultFolderToken` | `''` | Where new documents, sheets, Bitable apps, and uploads go when a call omits a folder. |
| `defaultIdentity` | `auto` | `auto`, `user`, or `app`. `auto` uses the user when authorized and otherwise the app, reporting the fallback. |
| `toolPrefix` | `feishu_` | Rename the tools (for example `fs_`). |
| `requestTimeoutMs` | `30000` | Per-attempt timeout. |
| `maxRetries` | `2` | Total attempts for rate-limited or transient failures (capped at 6). |
| `enableTools` | `true` | Register the model-facing tools. |
| `enableOAuth` | `true` | Mount the `/api/feishu/*` routes (status, activity, config, OAuth). |
| `enableUi` | `true` | Show the floating panel. |
| `oauthRedirectUri` | auto | Override the callback. Empty means "use

plugins.description: 让 DeepSeek Harness 直接使用其他 AI 编码工具生态里的 MCP 服务器与插件——读已有配置而非要求作者重新移植，并明确报告哪些能跑、哪些缺密钥、哪些跑不了。
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-babel **让 DSH 直接使用其他 AI 编码工具生态里的 MCP 服务器、插件与斜杠命令。** > 读它们已有的配置，而不是要求插件作者为 DSH 重新移植一遍。 [![简体中文](https://img.shields.io/badge/lang-%E7%AE%80%E4%BD%93%E4%B8%AD%E6%96%87-red.svg)](README.md) [![English](https://img.shields.io/badge/lang-English-blue.svg)](README.en.md) [![test](https://github.com/Oliveryfaso/dsh-babel/actions/workflows/test.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/Oliveryfaso/dsh-babel/actions/workflows/test.yml) [![license](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-2EA44F?style=flat)](LICENSE) [![GitHub stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/Oliveryfaso/dsh-babel?style=flat&label=%E2%98%85)](https://github.com/Oliveryfaso/dsh-babel) [![DSH plugin](https://img.shields.io/badge/DSH-plugin-0f766e.svg)](https://github.com/Oliveryfaso/dsh-babel) [![dsh-plugin topic](https://img.shields.io/badge/topic-dsh--plugin-2563eb.svg)](https://github.com/topics/dsh-plugin)
> dsh-babel 是社区维护的 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）插件，并非 DeepSeek AI 官方产品。 ## 它解决什么问题 插件作者要支持一个平台，就得为它单独写一份目录。一个典型的多平台插件会带六到八个这样的目录： ``` .claude-plugin .codex-plugin .cursor .gemini-extension.json ... ``` DSH 的那个格子通常是空的。dsh-babel 换个思路：**作者不用动，DSH 这边读他们已有的 `.mcp.json` / `commands/`**，把 N×M 的移植问题变成 N×1。 同时它做一件别家没做的事：**装之前就告诉你哪个能跑、哪个缺密钥、哪个根本跑不起来**——而不是装上去之后静默失败。 ## 功能 - **发现**：扫描 Claude Code 与 Codex 插件目录下的 `.mcp.json`，以及两种斜杠命令文件（`.md` / `.toml`）；根目录可配置。 - **归一化**：把多种 `.mcp.json` 方言（带 `mcpServers` 包装的 / 裸顶层的 / Codex 专有键的）降成**一套中间表示**。 - **预检**：四类检查把"静默失败"变成"明确原因"——依赖命令是否在 `PATH`、守护进程是否在跑（如 Docker socket）、密钥是否可用、版本是否未固定。 - **兼容性报告**：把每个服务器归入「可用 / 需密钥 / 不可用」，每条都附具体原因。 - **命令注册**：把发现到的斜杠命令注册进 DSH，支持 `{{args}}` / `$ARGUMENTS` / `$1` 参数替换。 - **MCP 注册**：连上 stdio 或 streamable-http 服务器，用 DSH 自己的 `createMcpToolDefinition` 注册工具。 - **密钥解析**：`process.env` 优先，其次 macOS 钥匙串的**白名单**（仅 GitHub token 家族）——绝不无差别翻钥匙串。 - **展示元数据**：`locale/` 文案与图标，配置项由 schemastery schema 声明，设置界面可渲染。 ## 安装 ```bash # 从 GitHub plugin_manager install_bundle github:Oliveryfaso/dsh-babel # 或本地目录 plugin_manager install_bundle /绝对/路径/dsh-babel ``` 也可以在 DSH Desktop 里走 **设置 → 插件 → 添加插件**，填入仓库地址或本地路径。 安装后默认 **dry-run**：只在日志里打印兼容性报告，**不注册任何东西**。 ## 配置 配置项由 schemastery schema 声明，因此会出现在 **设置 → 插件 → dsh-babel** 的配置界面里： | 配置项 | 默认 | 说明 | |---|---|---| | `roots` | `[]` | 扫描根目录；字符串路径或 `{ source, path }`。留空时使用默认的 Claude / Codex 插件目录 | | `dryRun` | `true` | 只报告，不注册。要真正注册必须先设为 `false` | | `logReport` | `true` | 把兼容性报告打印到日志 | | `registerCommands` | `false` | 注册发现到的斜杠命令（需 `dryRun: false`） | | `registerMcp` | `false` | 注册预检通过（`severity: ok`）的 MCP 服务器（需 `dryRun: false`） | 开启真注册： ```yaml config: dryRun: false registerCommands: true registerMcp: true ``` ## 兼容矩阵（诚实版） | 外部形态 | 覆盖 | 说明 | |---|---|---| | MCP `.mcp.json`（stdio） | ✅ 高 | 免密钥、依赖命令存在的，基本可用 | | MCP `.mcp.json`（http/sse） | ✅ 高 | 依赖 bearer token 的会标「需密钥」 | | MCP（依赖宿主运行时变量） | ⚠️ 有损 | `CODEX_*` / `CLAUDE_*` 等对方宿主注入的变量，DSH 没有，标为不可用 | | MCP（OAuth） | ❌ 无对应 | `oauth_resource` 等 DSH 无等价物，丢弃并告知 | | 技能 `skills/*/SKILL.md` | ✅ 高 | 格式统一（由 skills-manager 等已有实现覆盖） | | 斜杠命令 `commands/*` | ✅ 已实现 | 发现 + 归一化 + 报告 + 注册 | | Hooks | ⚠️ 有损 | DSH 仅 7 个点、仅 command handler | | 子代理 `agents/*` | ⚠️ 降级 | DSH 无注册接口，只能降级为技能 | | 插件 UI / mods | ❌ 不支持 | 必须用 DSH client 插件重写，无法移植 | ## 报告长什么样 在一台装了 Claude Code 与 Codex 插件的机器上，首次加载会打印： ``` === dsh-babel 兼容性报告 === 文件: 28 服务器: 28 方言: {"bare":14,"wrapped":14} 传输: {"stdio":17,"streamable-http":11} 结论: 可用 14 / 需密钥 5 / 不可用 9 ✗ 不可用 (9): laravel-boost [stdio] BLOCKED - [command] command not on PATH: php terraform [stdio] BLOCKED - [daemon] docker installed but not running (no socket / probe failed) - [secret] missing credential: TFE_TOKEN codex_app [stdio] BLOCKED - [env] depends on CODEX_MCP_NODE_PATH (other-harness runtime), not available in DSH ``` 这就是这个插件的第二个价值：**明确告诉你为什么跑不起来**，而不是让用户以为「DSH 很烂」。 ## 目录结构 ``` index.js 插件入口（apply + schemastery Config，Cordis 宿主插件形式） cordis.patch.yml bundle patch（插入 dsh-babel 一行） locale/zh.json 卡片展示文案（标题 + 简介） locale/en.json same, in English icon.svg 插件图标 lib/normalize.mjs 内核：方言 → IR lib/discover.mjs 发现：遍历文件系统找声明 lib/preflight.mjs 预检：命令 / daemon / 密钥 / 版本 lib/secrets.mjs 密钥解析：env 为主 + 钥匙串白名单兜底 lib/commands.mjs 命令归一化：.md / .toml → 命令 IR lib/register.mjs 命令注册：ctx.commands.register + 参数替换 lib/register-mcp.mjs MCP 注册：连接 + createMcpToolDefinition + 工具注册 lib/report.mjs 报告：聚合 + 文本渲染 bin/dsh-babel.mjs CLI runner（本地测试用） test/ 单测 + 冒烟 docs/ 详细文档 CHANGELOG.md 版本变更记录 ``` ## 开发与测试 ```bash npm test # 全部单测（75 断言） node test/mcp-smoke.mjs # MCP 注册冒烟（需本地 symlink 到 DSH 包 + 真实服务器） node bin/dsh-babel.mjs # 直接跑一次报告 ``` ## 文档 - [功能详解](docs/FEATURES.md) - [配置参考](docs/CONFIG.md) - [兼容性说明](docs/COMPATIBILITY.md) - [架构与中间表示](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md) - [版本变更](CHANGELOG.md) ## 许可证 [MIT](LICENSE)

plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-claude-code-theme **Claude Desktop's visual language for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI.** Warm paper neutrals, terracotta accent, readable prose, quiet layered surfaces and a continuous composer — applied through DSH's own theme extension point, not by patching its stylesheets. [![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-claude-code-theme.svg)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-claude-code-theme) [![license](https://img.shields.io/npm/l/dsh-claude-code-theme.svg)](./LICENSE)
## Before and after Stock DSH — right-aligned bubble on a blue-tinted canvas, soft 12–28px corners, a floating composer with a circular send button: With the theme — a deeper sidebar, a raised right-hand panel, prose set for reading, compact tool summaries, and a continuous composer: Light mode, on Claude's cream canvas with white raised sheets: --- ## Install ```sh dsh plugin install dsh-claude-code-theme ``` Or add the row to your profile's `cordis.patch.yml` and its package to the profile's `dsh.profile.bundles`: ```yaml - insert: - id: claude-code-theme name: dsh-claude-code-theme ``` Reload the Web GUI. There is nothing to switch on: the theme composes over whichever palette you already use, so `light`, `dark` and `system` all keep working. ## What changes **Colour.** DSH's design system has three token tiers, and the theme works on all three: | Tier | What it is | What the theme does | | --- | --- | --- | | `--dsw-static-*` | The raw colour ramps | Retints DSH's blue-tinted greys to Claude's warm paper greys, and DeepSeek blue to terracotta. The alias tier resolves through these, so this alone recolours most of the application. | | `--dsw-alias-*` | The semantic roles components consume | Pins the roles Claude treats differently: a cream canvas under raised sheets, a terracotta primary button and focus ring, warm hairlines, and text that stops short of pure white on dark. | | `--dsw-specific-*` | Named surfaces | Retunes the sidebar, composer, bubbles, menus and code surfaces. | **Surface hierarchy.** Claude Desktop stacks depth rather than flattening it, so the theme gives each column its own level instead of one shared grey: | Region | Dark | Light | | --- | --- | --- | | Sidebar | `#111110` (deepest) | `#f5f3ec` | | Canvas | `#171716` | `#faf9f5` | | Raised sheets — cards, composer, right panel | `#1d1d1b` | `#ffffff` | The right panel becomes a raised sheet separated by a hairline instead of floating as a detached card. **Geometry.** DSH routes **280 `border-radius` declarations through six `--dsw-radius-*` tokens** (measured across all 179 shipped UI bundles), so the theme re-points the scale itself: | Token | DSH | Theme | | --- | --- | --- | | `--dsw-radius-xs` | 4px | 4px | | `--dsw-radius-sm` | 8px | 6px | | `--dsw-radius-md` | 12px | 8px | | `--dsw-radius-lg` | 16px | 12px | | `--dsw-radius-xl` | 20px | 16px | | `--dsw-radius-panel` | 28px | 20px | The corners that bypass the scale are reached through the stable `data-slot` and `data-*` hooks rather than a build hash. **Typography.** This is the part that most decides whether the result reads as a product or as a costume. Claude Desktop is a reading surface, so the transcript is set in the UI sans at a comfortable line height, and monospace is kept for the things that are actually code: | | Treatment | | --- | --- | | Assistant prose | UI sans, 1.65 line height, normal heading letter-spacing | | Inline code, code blocks, tool output | Monospace | | Sidebar, header, composer | UI sans | | Code-block banner | Sentence case, not shouted uppercase | **Transcript.** Your turn is a right-aligned bubble on a quiet surface; the assistant's is prose on the canvas; tool calls collapse into single-line summaries (`Ran 2 commands ›`) that expand in place, which is how Claude Desktop keeps a long working session scannable. **Composer.** One continuous rounded surface: the editor and the controls share a single card with no divider between them, the submit control is a circle, and focus draws a soft terracotta ring rather than a hard outline. **Chrome.** Quiet navigation rows instead of an elevated primary button, hover states limited to enabled controls, `focus-visible` rings for keyboard use, and thin warm scrollbars. ## Customisation Everything the component layer decides reads a `--cct-*` property declared once on `body`, so you can retune it from your own CSS without patching the package: ```css body { /* A serif reading face, the way long-form prose is often set. */ --cct-prose: Georgia, "Songti SC", serif; /* Roomier or tighter surfaces. */ --cct-composer-radius: 24px; --cct-control-radius: 6px; --cct-editor-inset: 20px; } ``` | Knob | Default | Purpose | | --- | --- | --- | | `--cct-sans` | system UI stack | UI face, including the sidebar and composer | | `--cct-prose` | `var(--cct-sans)` | Face used for assistant prose only | | `--cct-mono` | DSH's code stack | Code, tool output and paths | | `--cct-control-radius` | `8px` | Buttons, rows, chips, code blocks | | `--cct-composer-radius` | `18px` | The composer surface | | `--cct-editor-inset` | `16px` | Composer text inset from its edge | | `--cct-focus` | brand primary | Focus ring colour | To retune colours instead, stack your own layer on top — later layers win per token: ```js ctx.theme.overrideTokens('my-tweaks', { '--dsw-alias-brand-primary': { light: '#c96442', dark: '#d97757' }, }) ``` ## How it works The plugin is a browser half plus an inert host row. The browser half (`lib/client.js`) does exactly two things, both inside one Cordis effect, so unloading or HMR removes the theme completely: 1. Calls `ctx.theme.overrideTokens('dsh-claude-code-theme', …)` with 174 tokens as `{ light, dark }` pairs. This is DSH's documented third-party theme extension point. The service stacks the layer over the active palette and `ui-layout` writes it as inline custom properties on `` — which is why the theme outranks the base palette sheets without `!important`, and why overriding the `--dsw-static-*` ramps propagates to every alias that resolves through them. 2. plugins.description: Normify · DSH 插件：把项目架构写成归一化的分形模块树，三层校验（写时 / 校验 / 冻结回执）、30 个 normify_* 工具 + normify-gen 技能，一键渲染单文件交互式架构图；支持伴随式开发（change_open → brief → check → 实施 → refresh → change_close）。
plugins.readme_text:
English · 简体中文

Normify · 归一化框架图构建器

把整个项目描述成一棵"人机共读"的分形模块树：AI 负责分析与创作，确定性引擎负责校验、编译与渲染 —— 点开任意模块，就是一张更精细的子图。

--- ## 0. 一句话 Normify 是 **DeepSeek Harness（DSH）插件**，也是**一套写给 AI 用的开发流程**： - **给 AI 的**：`normify-gen` 技能 + **31 个 `normify_*` 工具** —— 让模型把仓库分析成模块树结构数据， 并在后续开发中**先建图后编程、伴随编程改图**（计划态建树 → 逐个实现 → 关单收尾）。 - **给引擎的**：零容忍校验（L1 写时 / L2 全项目 / L3 冻结）+ 确定性编译（`tree.json` 等四件产物，SHA-256 冻结） + 渲染数据（`renders/`，决定"每一层怎么画"）。 - **给人的**：**单文件交互式架构图**（`normify.html`）—— 逐层下钻、悬停看介绍、一键中英切换、深链接、 多树、**API 直连箭头**、跨层聚合、缩放与搜索。零依赖，双击即开。 > 它不是"生成一张图就结束"的工具：结构数据与代码**互为契约**，每次改动都能被 `normify_sync` 检出漂移， > 并以 `normify_change_close`（**0 error 强制**）收尾，让"代码 → 架构图"永远同步。


引擎层：14 个模块、API 直连箭头（箭头锚定到具体 API 行）、带标签的子系统依赖、跨层聚合虚线

## 1. 它解决什么问题 | 痛点 | Normify 的做法 | | --- | --- | | 架构图一画完就过期 | 结构数据是**可校验的源数据**：`normify_sync` 按 `fingerprint` 检出漂移，`normify_change_close` 强制 0 error 收尾 | | 图太粗，看不出接口契约 | 粒度到**单一功能单元**，API 写在叶子上，箭头可锚定到具体 API（`from_api`/`to_api`） | | AI 改代码时"看不见全局" | `normify_brief` 给出目标模块契约、影响面（谁依赖我）、规则约束与验收清单 | | 设计先写代码后补文档，必然漂移 | **计划态先建树**（`state: planned`）→ 实现后 `normify_module_refresh(activate)` 自动转 active | | 结构规范靠人自觉 | `policy.yml` 架构规则（依赖方向 / 禁依赖 / 无环 / 深度 / 跨树 / 命名）由 `validate` 强制执行 | | 大仓库一次生成太重 | 增量再生成：只重建受影响子树，`layouts_to_review` 点名要复核的层 | ## 2. 核心特性 ### 2.1 数据模型：分形 + 零冗余 - **唯一元素**：整个数据库由无数个结构完全相同的**基本模块**构成（每个模块 = 一个 Markdown 文件）。 - **只存 `parent`**：单方向引用，`children` 由索引导出 —— 不会出现"父子各说各话"。 - **API 只在叶子存一次**：聚合、统计、索引全部是编译期派生数据（`tree.json` / `api-index.json`）。 - **两类边**：containment（树边，导航骨架）+ dependency（箭头，可跨子树、跨树，按 `kind` 着色）。 - **路径式 id + 不变 uid**：AI 沿 id 逐层定位（类二分查找）；`uid` 在改名/移动时保持不变，git diff 稳定。 - **深度不设上限**（0.5.0 起）：想有多细就拆多细，深度不再成为"合并模块"的理由。 ### 2.2 三层校验，fail-closed | 层 | 时机 | 内容 | | --- | --- | --- | | **L1** | 每次写入 | 必填字段、id 文法、uid、parent 一致性、双语长度、source/apis/deps 形状、state/replacement | | **L2** | `normify_validate` | 全项目：唯一性、文件↔id 映射、叶子/非叶子规则、API 键唯一、依赖目标、环、渲染数据交叉校验、架构规则、变更日志、（可选）仓库证据（source 存在性 + 指纹一致） | | **L3** | `normify_build` | 任何 error 都不产出产物；产出即 SHA-256 冻结进 `receipt.json` | 每条诊断都带 `severity / code / message / subject / evidence / supportedFixes` —— **AI 可自行修复**。 ### 2.3 渲染器：单文件、可下钻、API 直连 - 单文件 HTML（内联 CSS/JS，**零外部依赖**、零遥测），双击即开，可直接归档/发人。 - 逐层下钻 + 面包屑 + 搜索（模块名/API）+ 大纲视图 + API 浏览器。 - **API 直连**：叶子框内展示 API 明细行，箭头锚定到具体 API 行的端口；同一 API 行上的多条边自动扇形分离。 - 跨层依赖聚合为虚线 `×N`（默认隐藏，工具栏或 `?agg=1` 开启，悬停看明细）。 - 深链接：`#module=`、`#api=`、`#view=outline`、`?lang=zh|en`、`?agg=1`；缩放 / 悬停高亮 / 明暗主题。 - **几何自检**：仓库自带 `check-geometry.mjs`，逐层断言"线不出界 / 不贴框 / 不穿框 / 不压线"。 ### 2.4 伴随开发：先建图后编程 ``` change_open → brief → check → module_batch(state=planned) → 【写代码】 → module_refresh(activate) → change_close(0 error 强制) → verified + revision.after ``` - **计划态**：源码还不存在也能先建树（`fingerprint: pending`），`validate` 放行； - **禁止假激活**：源码没落地就 `activate` 直接被拒； - **收尾即闭环**：`change_close` 会刷新指纹 → 校验（0 error 强制）→ 编译（可选渲染）→ 标记 `verified`， 任何一步失败都不关闭，变更保持原状态； - **改图随代码**：`normify_sync` 用 `git diff` + 未跟踪文件定位受影响模块与指纹漂移，`module_patch` 跟随更新。 ### 2.5 架构规则先行（policy.yml） | 规则 | 作用 | | --- | --- | | `dependency-direction` | 层顺序即允许的依赖方向（如 plugin → tools → engine），可控制同层是否允许 | | `forbid-dependency` | 禁止某些 from → to 的依赖（可按 kind / state 过滤） | | `acyclic` | 依赖图禁止成环（可含跨树） | | `max-depth` | id 段数上限（**可选**：不写就是不限，0.5.0 起默认不限） | | `cross-tree` | 跨树依赖策略：`forbid` / `allow` / `require-to-api` | | `naming` | 作用域内 id 段的命名正则 | 安装后 `normify_validate` / `normify_build` / `normify_check` 全部强制执行；**违规先改设计，不能绕过**。 ## 3. 最新变化 ### v0.5.4 · 把"第二轮 A/B 实测"暴露的 4 个工具缺陷修掉（当前版本） 第二轮 A/B 换了题目（**表格公式引擎 + CLI**，同一份规范、隐藏黑盒 88 项、外加**差分模糊测试**）。 两组最终 B 88/88、A 87/88（差异只有一条 §5.2 语义）；这一版修的是**工具侧**新暴露的 4 个坑： - **`mode:"patch"` 的静默 no-op 被拦下**：原来 `items:[{patch:{id, tags:[...]}}]`（少一层包装）会返回 `ok:true, count:1` 却**一个字段都没改**——最危险的"假成功"。现在直接报 `args/invalid-patch`， evidence 里给出收到的键与正确形状 `{patch:{id, patch:{...}}}`；单模块 `normify_module_patch` 传空补丁 同样报 `args/empty-patch`（只给 `expect_updated_at` 也不再静默通过）。 - **`normify_module_refresh` 不再强依赖 git**：`repoRoot` 不是 git 仓库时，以前直接 `refresh/git-failed` 失败（实测中 AI 只能 `git init` 才能激活模块）。现在改成**降级**：指纹照常重算、 `state` 照常激活，`revision` 保持模块原值，并给出 `refresh/git-unavailable` 警告与修法。 - **`change_open` 的 `acceptance` 报错具体化**：以前把 `{zh,en}` 写进 acceptance 只有一句笼统报错； 现在明确写出"**第 N 条不是非空字符串（收到 …）：验收标准只接受纯字符串**"，并提示双语描述写进 `title`/`intent`。 - **`normify_help` 支持 `topic:"tool:<工具名>"`**：`tools` 主题现在每个工具都带**必填/可选**摘要， 新主题可按需打印**完整参数树**（类型 / 描述 / 必填，由注册表实时生成、与运行时校验同源）。 实测里 AI 为确认 `mode=patch` 的嵌套形状去读了插件源码——这条主题正是为了消灭这种绕路。 ### v0.5.3 · 把「伴随编程实测」暴露的 4 个摩擦点修掉 这四个问题来自一次真实的 A/B 对照实验：两个 AI 用同一份规范写同一个后端，一个带插件走伴随流程、一个纯手写 （最终代码在隐藏黑盒验收上都是 **42/42**）。插件组多交付了 41 模块 / 110 API / 10 层的结构数据，但也踩到了下面 4 个坑： - **`normify_help` 支持 `topic`**：此前它完全忽略入参，只返回同一份字段速查 —— 实测里 AI 为了拿准 `change_open` / `layout_upsert` / `change_close` 的参数名，只能去读插件源码（多花约 4 分钟）。 现在按主题返回：`fields`（默认）/ `deps`（箭头与 API 直连）/ `renders` / `flow`（伴随流程）/ `tools`（工具清单）/ `policy` / `errors`（常见诊断码与修法）/ `all`；**传错主题会直接报错并列出可用主题**，不再静默忽略。 - **项目初始化通道**：新增第 31 个工具 `normify_project_init` —— 建 `normify-/` + 默认架构规则， 可选 `root` 一步创建"计划态根模块"（幂等）；同时 `normify_change_open` 现在也会**自动建项目目录** （此前报 `project/no-modules`，AI 只能用 `module_batch {items:[],dry_run:true}` 绕过去）； `normify_brief` 遇到不存在的模块会给出"先 init / 先建树 / 改用 task"的可执行提示。 - **批量诊断的因果链**：一条 `label-too-long` 曾连带出 3 条 `dep/target-missing`（因为 L1 失败的模块会被移出批次工作集）， AI 只能去读源码才能确认根因。现在连带错误改报 `dep/target-dropped` / `structure/parent-dropped`， 在 message 与 evidence 里点明**根因诊断码**，并在失败响应的 `root_causes` 里直接列出被丢弃的模块（附 `hint`）。 - **「API 直连」引导**：两端都声明了 API 却没写 `from_api` / `to_api` 的箭头，`normify_validate` 会给出**聚合** warning `dep/unanchored`（条数 + 前 3 条示例）。这正是实验里被浪费的能力：110 条 API 声明，54 条箭头 0 条锚定 —— 不锚定，箭头就只能落在框边，钉不到 API 行上。**引导≠放宽**：锚错键仍然是 error。 ### v0.5.2 · 修掉三处会写坏数据的真实缺陷 - **`normify_module_upsert` 的必填表不再丢失**：`parameters.required` 恢复为 `["frontmatter"]`， `frontmatter` 的 9 个必填字段（uid / id / parent / name / description / source / revision / updated_at / fingerprint） 也重新出现在 schema 里。此前嵌套 schema 被二次编译，必填表被整段丢掉 —— 模型看到的约束与运行时实际校验不一致。 - **`normify_module_move` 迁移渲染数据时重写内容**：`id` / `order` / `groups.children` / `edge_hints` 全部改写到新 id， 并同步维护**旧父级**（删掉已迁出子模块的引用）与**新父级**（把新 id 补进 `order`）。 修复前：move 完之后项目立刻被 L2 判为 `layout/id-mismatch` + `layout/order-child` 等（实测 8–9 个 error，0.5.2 后为 0）。 - **晋升为容器时不再把 API 留在容器上**：叶子被晋升（显式 `normify_module_promote`、写子模块自动晋升、move 到叶子底下） 时，容器上残留的 `apis` 会被摘除，并回报 `structure/api-dropped-on-promote` 警告（附丢失的 API 键清单）—— 修复前项目会直接卡在 `api/non-leaf`。 - **API 默认全展开**：渲染数据字段 `max_api_rows` 缺省 **0 = 全部展开**，叶子上的 API 一行不折叠；需要收窄时显式写 1..48。 - 三处缺陷各自配了回归断言：`tests/regression-0.5.2.mjs`（34 项，全绿）。 ### v0.5.1 · 渲染器防重叠（线压线 12 → 0） - **修复连线共线重叠**：28 层合计 **12 处 → 0 处**。四处根因： ① 首选路由只判"不穿别人的框"，从不检查是否压到已画的线 → 改为只接受 `violations === 0` 的候选； ② API 锚定端口没有端口分离（同一 API 行被多条边共用） → 行内 ±5.5px 扇形分离； ③ API 端口落在上下边时被放进框内部 → 上下边退回按边均匀分离； ④ `segClear` 整块跳过源/目标框 → 新增"进入自身框内部"检查（内缩 2px）。 - 节点/分组间距 170 → 220，给密集层更多自由通道。 ### v0.5.0 · 取消模块数量上限 - **删除 `MAX_DEPTH = 12`** 硬限制：树可以一直下钻到"单一功能单元"；需要限层时用 `policy.yml` 的 `max-depth` 规则显式声明（`maxDepth` 放宽到 1..64）。 - SKILL：目标深度改为"不设上限"，单批上限 40 → 200，新增"每叶 API 尽量 3–5 条"的粒度指引。
更早的版本（v0.4.x / v0.3 / v0.2 / v0.1） - **v0.4.1**：渲染器 v3 定稿（自由通道走线、viewBox 全几何自适应、API 直连、跨层聚合、缩放与悬停）； `normify_sync` 识别**未跟踪的新文件**（`git ls-files --others`）。 - **v0.4.0**：伴随开发（`state: pla

plugins.description: TypeSafe Jev for DeepSeek Harness, the Model Context Protocol, and plain Node: typed judgments instead of prose, offline by default.
plugins.readme_text:
# jevcore
[![dshfind](https://dshfind.com/api/badge/PerryLink/jevcore?metric=downloads)](https://dshfind.com/plugins/PerryLink/jevcore?ref=badge)

[![DSH Market](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/2BingLing/dsh-market/master/assets/readme/badge-listed-en.svg)](https://dsh.market/)
[![OpenSSF Scorecard](https://api.securityscorecards.dev/projects/github.com/PerryLink/jevcore/badge)](https://api.securityscorecards.dev/projects/github.com/PerryLink/jevcore)
[![jevcore MCP server](https://glama.ai/mcp/servers/PerryLink/jevcore/badges/score.svg)](https://glama.ai/mcp/servers/PerryLink/jevcore)

TypeSafe [Jev](https://typesafe.ai) for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)
and any other MCP host.

Jev is not a chat model. It answers typed questions — `noul` (yes/no), `choice`, `score` — and returns
calibrated probabilities. It does not write prose, and asking it to is a category error. This project
gives an agent exactly that surface, and nothing more.

**Offline by default. Egress disclosed. Nothing default-on.**

---

**📖 Ecosystem knowledge base** — measured data, not marketing: [plugin development guide · plugin-selection data · maintenance criteria](https://perrylink.github.io/dsh-plugin-guide/).

<!-- star-cta -->
## ⭐ 如果它帮到了你

这个插件是 [DSH 插件家族](https://github.com/PerryLink)的一员（40+ 个，全部 Apache-2.0）。如果你在用，**给个 star** —— 它不会解锁任何功能，但会让下一个人在搜索里更容易找到它。

*English:* part of a 40+ plugin family for DeepSeek Harness. If it is useful, **a star helps the next person find it** — nothing is gated behind it.


## Three packages, one decision layer

| Package | What it is | Use it when |
|---|---|---|
| [`jevcore`](packages/core) | The decisions. Imports nothing from DeepSeek Harness or Cordis. | You want Jev in a plain script, a service, or your own harness |
| [`jevcore-dsh`](packages/dsh) | The DSH plugin: one service, three tools, two opt-in gates | You are running DeepSeek Harness |
| [`jevcore-mcp`](packages/mcp) | The same three tools over MCP, with a stdio binary | Your host speaks MCP but is not DSH |

The adapters are thin on purpose. `packages/dsh` is four files: it declares tool schemas and
translates hook payloads. Everything decision-shaped — the primitives, the providers, the egress
contract, the policy, the gates — lives in core, so a new adapter cannot drift from the guarantees
the others make.
One runtime requirement differs across the three: `jevcore-dsh` tracks the harness and needs
Node `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0`, while `jevcore` and `jevcore-mcp` need `>=20`.

---

## Why this exists

Between 2026-09-17 and 09-20, nineteen plugins appeared that wire Jev into DSH. Auditing their source
found a consistent pattern: the module labelled *guard*, *gate*, or *warden* was also the module
shipping prompts, tool arguments, and file contents to a third party, and the README generally did not
say so. Several were enabled by default. One gate could be reconfigured by the model it was guarding.

This project is the same idea with those failure modes designed out:

| Property | How it is guaranteed here |
|---|---|
| No network call unless you ask for one | Default provider is an offline mock; the live path needs both `provider: live` and a resolved credential |
| Every transmission named before it happens | One startup log line per feature: `off` or `SENDS <feature> { fields }` |
| Gates register nothing when disabled | Verified by test, not by policy — a disabled gate adds no event listener at all |
| The model cannot widen its own constraints | No tool exposes gate configuration |
| A judge that cannot answer never means "allow" | Undecided resolves through explicit config, defaulting to `ask` |

---

## The egress contract

This is the part worth reading before installing.

Transmission is decided per feature, and every feature defaults to off. The plugin prints its own
contract at load:

```
[jevcore] provider=mock  endpoint=none  egress=OFF  (no network calls will be made; every answer is synthetic)
[jevcore] ready - provider=mock - gates: safety=off context=off
```

With `provider: live` and every feature enabled, the same report becomes explicit about what leaves:

```
[jevcore] provider=live  endpoint=https://api.typesafe.ai  egress=ON
[jevcore]   SENDS  tool:jev_ask  { state<=16000c questions<=4000c }
[jevcore]   SENDS  tool:jev_rank  { state<=16000c questions<=4000c }
[jevcore]   SENDS  tool:jev_check  { state<=16000c questions<=4000c }
[jevcore]   SENDS  gate:safety  { state<=8000c questions<=2000c }
[jevcore]   SENDS  gate:context  { state<=6000c questions<=2000c }
[jevcore]   redaction is best-effort; it removes named fields and known secret shapes, and cannot
             recognise an unrecognised secret in free text
```

| Feature | Off by default? | What it sends |
|---|---|---|
| `tool:jev_ask` | runs when the model calls it | the arguments the model passed, after redaction |
| `tool:jev_rank` | runs when the model calls it | the query plus every candidate |
| `tool:jev_check` | runs when the model calls it | the claim and its evidence |
| `gate:safety` | **yes — explicit opt-in** | the tool name, its arguments, the workspace root |
| `gate:context` | **yes — explicit opt-in** | a large tool result the agent just received |

The tools transmit only when the model chooses to call them, which is visible in the transcript. The
gates would run on every matching tool call, which is not, so they are opt-in.

### Redaction, and its honest limit

Before anything is sent, `src/redact.ts` runs two passes: values under sensitive field names
(`password`, `token`, `apiKey`, `authorization`, …) are replaced wholesale, and secret-shaped strings
that survive into free text are pattern-matched (`Bearer …`, `sk-…`, `ts_live_…`, AWS/GitHub/Google
key shapes, JWTs, private-key headers, credentials in connection strings).

This is a mitigation, not a permission. A secret that sits under an unrecognised key name *and* does
not match a known shape will pass through. If that possibility is unacceptable for your workload, do
not enable the live provider.

---

## Install

### As a DeepSeek Harness plugin

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add jevcore-dsh
```

Or from a checkout:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add /absolute/path/to/jevcore/packages/dsh
```

`packages/dsh` imports `jevcore` by name, so a checkout also needs core
resolvable from the profile (`add /absolute/path/to/jevcore/packages/core`).

Then confirm the row activated — the plugin list should show `jev` as `active`,
not `failed` — and check the startup report in the log.

### As an MCP server

For a host that speaks MCP, the same three tools are available over stdio:

```sh
npx -y jevcore-mcp
```

To wire it into DeepSeek Harness specifically, install a configuration-only bundle
whose patch inserts the harness's own MCP client:

```yml
- insert:
    - id: jev-mcp
      name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client'
      config:
        serverName: jev
        transport: stdio
        command: npx
        args: ['-y', 'jevcore-mcp']
        env:
          TYPESAFE_API_KEY: '<the key>'
        failOnStartupError: true
```

The env map is not optional: DSH strips every credential-shaped name — anything
containing KEY, PASSWORD, SECRET or TOKEN, in any case — from the environment it
hands a spawned server, then merges this map back in afterwards. A key exported in
your shell never arrives, and the server stays on the offline mock without
reporting an error.

The provider is chosen from the environment:

| Variable | Effect |
|---|---|
| `TYPESAFE_API_KEY` | Selects the TypeSafe route when present |
| `OPENROUTER_API_KEY` | Selects the OpenRouter route when present and no TypeSafe key is set |
| `JEV_PROVIDER` | `mock`, `live`, or `openrouter` — overrides the heuristic above |
| `TYPESAFE_MODEL` / `OPENROUTER_MODEL` | Model id for the selected route |
| `TYPESAFE_BASE_URL` / `OPENROUTER_BASE_URL` | API root for the selected route |

With neither key it stays on the offline mock. Unlike the plugin, the MCP server
resolves its credential once at startup, so a missing key with
`JEV_PROVIDER=live` is a startup error rather than a per-call surprise.
